stories.title: Bareilly city magistrate under house arrest after resignation:Alankar Agnihotri refuses to withdraw resignation, denied permission to meet the DM
stories.summary: Bareilly City Magistrate Alankar Agnihotri, who resigned alleging insult to Shankaracharya, has been placed under house arrest. He is not being allowed to step out of his official residence. Standing inside the gate, the officer said that he could be taken to an undisclosed location at 3 am or later. The officer claimed that some upper-caste officers are in contact with him and that he received information from them. He alleged that his phone and the phone numbers of officials in touch with him have all been put under surveillance. Suspension after resignation Earlier, the government suspended Agnihotri following his resignation and ordered a departmental inquiry against him. However, his resignation has not yet been accepted. It is believed that the government will decide on accepting the resignation only after the inquiry is completed. Attached to Shamli, probe handed to commissioner At present, Agnihotri has been attached to Shamli. The Bareilly Commissioner has been entrusted with investigating the matter. The magistrate’s official vehicle has been withdrawn. On Tuesday morning at around 11 am, he reached the Collectorate to meet the District Magistrate, but was not allowed to enter. He staged a sit-in protest outside for nearly two hours. Since morning, he has gone back and forth between the Collectorate and his residence twice. ‘Will not withdraw resignation’ Speaking to Dainik Bhaskar, Magistrate Alankar Agnihotri said that he would not withdraw his resignation as he has lost faith in the government. He added that society would now decide what he should do next. He also demanded that President’s Rule be imposed in Uttar Pradesh. Shankaracharya assures support Late at night, Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand spoke to the City Magistrate over the phone. He told him that the entire Sanatani society is pleased with his stand. He further said that while the government had given him a position, society would grant him a much bigger role in the field of religion. Resignation on Republic Day Alankar Agnihotri had tendered his resignation on Republic Day. He cited the new UGC law and the alleged assault on Avimukteshwaranand’s disciples as the reasons behind his decision. He also wrote a five-page letter explaining his stand. Later, at around 7:30 pm, Agnihotri went to meet District Magistrate Avinash Singh at his residence. Allegation of illegal detention, officials deny After coming out, the City Magistrate claimed that he was held hostage at the DM’s residence for 45 minutes and was released only on the instructions of the SSP. However, the ADM dismissed these allegations as baseless. At around 11 pm, Agnihotri vacated his government accommodation. He remains in Bareilly and is currently staying at the residence of an acquaintance.

stories.title: Fiancée killed after opposing groom’s second marriage plan:Court finds six guilty; says, 'Body cut into 3 pieces and buried near river bank'
stories.summary: In the Rampur Payal murder case, 6 convicts, including her fiancé Jahangir, have been sentenced to life imprisonment. Even after the sentencing, all the convicts were seen smiling while sitting in the police vehicle. A video of this has also emerged. In it, fiancé Jahangir's father Tahir can be seen waving his hand. Actually, even after getting engaged to Payal, Jahangir was preparing to marry another girl. When Payal opposed this, Jahangir, along with his father, servant and 5 others, murdered Payal. After that, they cut the body into three pieces and buried it near the river. This incident took place on November 1, 2018. Following this, on November 13, 2018, Payal's brother filed a murder FIR at the City Kotwali. Rahil lives in the Ganj Kotwali area. He works in Rahil Construction. His elder brother works at the reception of a hotel in Mumbai. His sister Payal had passed 12th grade. Father used to work in a menthol factory. He is now at home after retirement. Mother Gazala (50) is a housewife. Rahil said - My sister Payal's engagement was with Jahangir, who lives in Thanakunda locality, on March 6, 2014. They were supposed to get married after 3 years. After the engagement, Jahangir kept talking to my sister continuously on the phone. The conversation between them continued for about 4 years. Meanwhile, Jahangir got into an affair with another girl from Ramnagar, Uttarakhand. Because of this, he was postponing the marriage with Payal. When my sister became suspicious about this, she talked to Jahangir about it. She also started protesting. During this time, Jahangir started planning a nikah with the Uttarakhand girl. When Payal didn't agree, plan was made to remove her from the way Rahil said that when Payal learned about Jahangir's marriage planning, she opposed it. But Jahangir didn't agree. When his sister insisted on marriage, Jahangir made a plan to remove her from the way. He told his father, Tahir Khan, associate Imroz, servant Nisar, Prabhjeet alias Sagar and relative Danish about the plan. Called sister to meet on November 1 On November 1, 2018, Jahangir called my sister to meet at the taxi stand located in Civil Lines. There, Jahangir and Imroz were standing with a scooter. Both of them took Payal on the scooter under false pretences to their farmhouse near the Kosi River. After this, everyone together killed Payal by striking her with an axe. Then they cut her body into 3 pieces. To avoid the police, everyone together dug a 4-foot deep pit at the farmhouse itself and buried the body parts in it. Brother filed missing report when sister didn't return On November 1, when sister Payal didn't return home, Rahil filed a missing person report at Ganj police station. After the investigation, the police registered a case on November 13. During this time, Jahangir was arrested. Then, on November 26, based on his identification, the body was recovered, and a post-mortem was conducted. After interrogating Jahangir, the police also registered cases against the other accused. After the case, Jahangir's father, Tahir, had fled. When police issued an attachment notice, Tahir surrendered within a week. Police filed chargesheet in 40 days Police conducted a swift investigation considering the seriousness of the case. The chargesheet was filed in court within 40 days. After this, the trial began. During this, 13 witnesses and other evidence were presented in court. ADJ-1 Court Judge Ajay Kumar Dixit found all charges proven and convicted all six accused, including Jahangir. Each convict was also fined Rs 35,000. Government lawyer Amit Saxena said - Police investigation recovered Payal's body in three pieces. The case was registered at the Ganj police station. Today, the court has sentenced life imprisonment to all 6 accused, including fiancé Jahangir, after finding them guilty.

stories.title: Irrigation department JE arrested for taking ₹2 lakh bribe:₹8 lakhs found from car and pocket in Meerut; threatened Officials after being caught
stories.summary: A JE (Junior Engineer) of the Irrigation Department was caught red-handed taking a bribe of 2 lakh rupees in Meerut. Besides the 2 lakhs, the Vigilance team also found 54 thousand rupees in the JE's pocket and 7.46 lakh rupees from his car. A total of 10 lakh rupees has been recovered. The Vigilance officer said that JE Brijraj Singh had demanded a bribe from a contractor in exchange for processing his payment. The contractor had been harassed for quite some time. After this, the contractor contacted the Vigilance. Vigilance prepared a trap strategy. After this, today, the contractor was sent to the JE. As soon as the contractor gave the amount to JE Brijraj Singh, the Vigilance team caught him. Currently, the Vigilance team is interrogating JE Brijraj Singh in a closed room. Meanwhile, after being caught, the JE started threatening Ankur and the Vigilance team as well. However, the team was not influenced by him. Ankur Singh, who lives in Mawana, has a firm named DS Contractors. His firm takes tenders for civil works of the Irrigation Department. Last year, they got the contract to clean the Machari Minor in the Ghaziabad region. This minor had been closed for a long time. Ankur Singh's firm had to clean the Machari Minor from 0.800 kilometers to 1.600 kilometers distance. An offline tender was requested for this. The tender was for Rs 8 lakh 3 thousand 644. After getting the tender, work started on December 1, 2025. The work was completed on December 30, 2025. After this, when Ankur went to the department for payment, he was asked for a bribe. JE said - Will process full payment as soon as share is received Ankur explained - This tender was issued offline by Executive Engineer Meerut Division Ganganagar. There was a lot of hassle during work allocation, too. After the work was completed, when it came time for payment, JE Brajraj Singh said that he is currently showing half the work as complete and processing half the payment. The remaining payment will be processed when they receive their share. 7. Payment was supposed to be Rs 7.54 lakh Contractor Ankur Singh said - This firm is registered in my father Dharm Singh's name, but he has become quite elderly. Therefore, I have to handle the work. The payment was supposed to be around Rs 7.54 lakh. On January 14, 2026, a payment of 4 lakh 32 thousand 644 rupees was received in my father's account. After deducting GST and labor cess, 3.71 lakh rupees remained. They were demanding 3 lakh rupees to make that payment. When Vigilance sent 2 lakh, the JE insisted on bringing one more lakh rupees. He threatened that payment had to be made by March 31. After that, even that payment won't happen. If this payment is not made, they won't let us get work in the future. Troubled contractor complained to Vigilance Ankur said - I was being tortured for many days. I came here to meet on Saturday too, but JE had gone to the field. Being troubled, I went to the vigilance office and filed a complaint. After getting in touch with vigilance, I arranged for 2 lakh rupees. Vigilance applied chemicals on the currency notes. Today, I reached JE Brajraj Singh with bundles of 500-500 rupee notes. After taking the bundle, JE Brajraj Singh put it in his drawer, and that's when the team caught him. After completing the operation, the vigilance team took the junior engineer to the police station.

stories.summary: मऊ में रोटरी क्लब के तत्वावधान में ताजोपुर के अमरवाड़ी स्कूल में मूक-बधिर बच्चों के साथ गणतंत्र दिवस मनाया गया। इस अवसर पर बच्चों को स्टेशनरी किट वितरित की गई और पौधरोपण किया गया। बच्चों ने विभिन्न सांस्कृतिक कार्यक्रमों से दर्शकों को मंत्रमुग्ध कर दिया। रोटरी क्लब के कई पदाधिकारी इस कार्यक्रम में उपस्थित रहे।

stories.title: सीने में दर्द से सेनानी पुत्रसहित दो लोगों की जान
stories.summary: कानपुर देहात में सर्दी के कारण स्वांस के मरीजों, किसानों, बच्चों और बुजुर्गों के लिए खतरा बढ़ गया है। हार्ट अटैक और ब्रेन स्ट्रोक के मामलों में वृद्धि हो रही है। हाल ही में, एक बुजुर्ग और एक स्वतंत्रता सेनानी के बेटे की अचानक मौत हो गई, जिससे मृतकों की संख्या 34 तक पहुँच गई है।

stories.title: Have universities begun to favor ideology over truth?
stories.summary: Have universities begun to favor ideology over truth?

stories.title: UP Crime: राजधानी में गुंडाराज! थार से रौंदने की कोशिश, कारोबारी लहूलुहान -कानून व्यवस्था पर उठे बड़े सवाल
stories.summary: Lucknow Crime: लखनऊ के पॉश इलाके विभूति खंड से सामने आई एक घटना ने कानून व्यवस्था को लेकर गंभीर सवाल खड़े कर दिए हैं। यहां देर रात कथित तौर पर दबंग युवकों ने एक कारोबारी को थार गाड़ी से कुचलने की कोशिश की। इस दौरान कारोबारी के दोनों पैरों पर वाहन चढ़ जाने से वह गंभीर रूप से घायल हो गया। घटना का वीडियो भी सामने आने की बात कही जा रही है, जिसके बाद मामला और सुर्खियों में आ गया है। पुलिस के अनुसार, घटना विभूति खंड थाना क्षेत्र स्थित समिट बिल्डिंग परिसर में हुई। यह इलाका शहर के प्रमुख व्यावसायिक और मनोरंजन स्थलों में गिना जाता है, जहां देर रात तक आवाजाही बनी रहती है।

stories.title: शंकराचार्य और योगी दोनों पूजनीय; प्रवीण तोगड़िया बोले- भाइयों में तकरार होती है, लेकिन...
stories.summary: प्रवीण तोगड़िया सोमवार शाम अयोध्या पहुंचे। उन्हें श्रीराम जन्मभूमि तीर्थ क्षेत्र महासचिव चंपतराय ने रामलला का दर्शन कराया। इस दौरान उन्होंने अविमुक्तेश्वरानंद विवाद पर कहा कि शंकराचार्य और योगी आदित्यनाथ पूजनीय हैं। भाइयों में तकरार हो जाती है लेकिन फिर सब ठीक हो जाएगा।

stories.title: Why Japan’s economic plans are sending jitters through global markets
stories.summary: Japanese prime minister's pledge to suspend consumption tax prompts turmoil in bond markets.

stories.title: कुलपति ने समेस्टर परीक्षा का औचक निरीक्षण किया
stories.summary: मां विंध्यवासिनी विश्वविद्यालय से संबंधित महाविद्यालयों में पहले समेस्टर की परीक्षाएं शांतिपूर्ण माहौल में प्रारंभ हुई। कुलपति प्रोफेसर शोभा गौंड ने जीडी बिनानी पीजी कॉलेज और केबीपीजी कॉलेज का निरीक्षण किया। उन्होंने परीक्षा की पारदर्शिता बनाए रखने और अनुचित साधनों पर अंकुश लगाने के लिए निर्देश दिए।

stories.title: Karnataka constitutes Gig Workers’ Welfare Board
stories.summary: According to the notification, the Labour Minister will be the ex-officio president of the board

stories.title: Uttar Pradesh government suspends Bareilly city magistrate Alankar Agnihotri; orders inquiry
stories.summary: As per the official order, Alankar Agnihotri has been found prima facie guilty of indiscipline based on a report submitted by the district magistrate of Bareilly

stories.title: मेरठ : पतंग उड़ाने से रोकने और डांटने पर 9वीं के छात्र ने किया सुसाइड
stories.summary: शास्त्रीनगर सेक्टर 3 में 14 वर्षीय अनंत चौहान ने पतंग उड़ाने पर मां द्वारा डांटे जाने के बाद आत्महत्या कर ली। वह अपने कमरे में फांसी पर लटका मिला। अनंत विद्या मंदिर स्कूल में 9वीं कक्षा का छात्र था। परिजनों ने उसे अस्पताल पहुंचाया, लेकिन डॉक्टर ने उसे मृत घोषित कर दिया।

stories.title: बैंक कर्मचारियों के हड़ताल का जनपद में व्यापक असर
stories.summary: देशभर में बैंक कर्मचारियों की हड़ताल का व्यापक असर मिर्जापुर जनपद में देखने को मिला। सभी सार्वजनिक और निजी बैंकों में काम-काज ठप रहा, जिससे लगभग 500 करोड़ रुपये का लेन-देन प्रभावित हुआ। कर्मचारियों ने पांच दिवसीय बैंकिंग व्यवस्था की मांग को लेकर प्रदर्शन किया।

stories.title: संदिग्ध हालात में फांसी लगने से विवाहिता की मौत
stories.summary: कदौरा। थाना क्षेत्र के ग्राम इकौना के मजरा निधानन का डेरा में सोमवार

stories.title: ‘सूर्यवंश के गौरव’ निबंध संग्रह का हुआ लोकार्पण
stories.summary: बस्ती में सामाजिक एवं साहित्यिक संस्थान द्वारा साहित्यिक संगोष्ठी, कवि सम्मेलन और सारस्वत सम्मान समारोह आयोजित किया गया। डॉ. राधेश्याम बंधु की अध्यक्षता में इस कार्यक्रम का संचालन डॉ. रामकृष्ण लाल जगमग ने किया। डॉ. राहुल को सम्मानित किया गया और मेधावी छात्रों को पुरस्कार देकर उत्साहवर्धन किया गया।

stories.title: कार्यशाला : रोबोटिक विधि से छोटा चीरा लगाकर सर्जरी में मिल रही सफलता
stories.summary: बस्ती में इंडियन मेडिकल एसोसिएशन की कार्यशाला में गैस्ट्रो इंटेस्टाइनल, किडनी प्रत्यारोपण और यूरोलॉजी से संबंधित आधुनिक शल्य तकनीकों पर चर्चा की गई। डॉ. अनिल कुमार श्रीवास्तव की अध्यक्षता में, विशेषज्ञों ने रोबोटिक सर्जरी की विधियों और फायदे पर जानकारी साझा की। चिकित्सकों को प्रोजेक्टर के माध्यम से सर्जरी के प्रदर्शन से ज्ञानवर्धन किया गया।

stories.title: मुड़कट्टी में हुई दंगल : अयोध्या के बाबा रविशंकर दास जीते
stories.summary: बस्ती के मुड़कट्टी व्यायामशाला में दंगल का आयोजन हुआ, जिसमें कई राज्यों के पहलवानों ने भाग लिया। मुख्य अतिथि महादेवा विधायक दूधराम थे। अयोध्या धाम के बाबा रवि शंकर ने कालीघटा को हराया, वहीं पंजाब के गौरव पहलवान ने दिल्ली के रॉकी पहलवान को मात दी। आयोजन पिछले 30 वर्षों से हो रहा है।

stories.title: जिले के 33 हजार छात्रों के खाते में गई छात्रवृत्ति
stories.summary: बस्ती, निज संवाददाता। एपीएन पीजी कॉलेज में छात्रवृत्ति स्वीकृति प्रमाण पत्र कार्यक्रम हुआ। कक्षा 9 व 10 के 17300 छात्रों को 343.92 लाख, कक्षा 11 व 12 के 15860 छात्रों को 324.98 लाख और उच्च कक्षा के 6114 छात्रों को 635.94 लाख रुपये वितरित किए गए। यह वित्तीय वर्ष 2025-26 के लिए है।

stories.title: मेरठ : उत्कृष्ट कार्य करने वाले बिजली अफसरों-कर्मचारियों को एमडी ने किया सम्मानित
stories.summary: गणतंत्र दिवस पर, प्रबन्ध निदेशक रवीश गुप्ता ने बिजली बिल राहत योजना और अन्य क्षेत्रों में उत्कृष्ट कार्य करने वाले अधिकारियों को सम्मानित किया। जितेश ग्रोवर को बीओडी में सराहनीय कार्य के लिए, जगदीश चन्द्र यादव, अरूण कुमार, और अन्य अधिकारियों को विभिन्न योजनाओं में योगदान के लिए प्रशस्ति पत्र दिए गए।

stories.title: अराजकतत्वों ने तोड़ी आंबेडकर की मूर्ति, आक्रोश
stories.summary: सोनभद्र के सिकरवार गांव में अराजकतत्वों ने सोमवार रात आंबेडकर की मूर्ति को तोड़ दिया। मंगलवार सुबह ग्रामीणों ने मूर्ति टूटी देख पुलिस को सूचना दी। पुलिस ने ग्रामीणों को आश्वासन दिया कि अराजकतत्वों के खिलाफ कार्रवाई की जाएगी और नई मूर्ति स्थापित की जाएगी।

stories.title: यूजीसी बिल के विरोध में छात्रों ने डीडीयू गेट के सामने किया प्रदर्शन
stories.summary: गोरखपुर विश्वविद्यालय के छात्रों ने प्रस्तावित यूजीसी बिल के खिलाफ प्रदर्शन किया। छात्रों का आरोप है कि यह बिल उच्च शिक्षा को प्रभावित करेगा। उन्होंने नारे लगाए कि शिक्षा बचाओ और स्वायत्तता बनाए रखो। प्रशासन ने छात्रों से शांति बनाए रखने की अपील की है और उनकी चिंताओं को संबंधित अधिकारियों तक पहुँचाने का आश्वासन दिया है।

stories.title: मेरठ में चाकू गोदकर किया पत्नी का कत्ल, एक पल में 6 बच्चों से छीन लिया मां का साया
stories.summary: कमालपुर में 26 जनवरी को रात करीब 8:30 बजे पति ने अपनी पत्नी समीना की चाकू से हत्या कर दी। दोनों के बीच लंबे समय से विवाद चल रहा था और पति ने पत्नी पर अवैध संबंधों का आरोप लगाया था। हत्या के बाद आरोपी फरार हो गया है, पुलिस ने उसकी गिरफ्तारी के लिए तीन टीमें बनाई हैं।

stories.title: पोखरी में नहाते समय युवक की डूबने से मौत
stories.summary: गाजीपुर के हथौड़ी गांव में एक युवक, ओम प्रकाश यादव, पोखरी में नहाते समय डूबकर मर गया। पैर फिसलने से वह गहरे पानी में चला गया। परिजनों ने उसे सीएचसी भदौरा पहुँचाया, जहाँ डॉक्टरों ने उसे मृत घोषित कर दिया। पुलिस ने शव का पंचनामा कर पीएम के लिए जिला चिकित्सालय भेजा।

stories.title: पांच दिन काम की मांग को लेकर बैंककर्मी हड़ताल पर, किया प्रदर्शन
stories.summary: देवरिया में बैंककर्मियों ने सप्ताह में पांच दिन काम की मांग को लेकर हड़ताल की। बैंकों में कामकाज प्रभावित हुआ और सुभाष चौक पर प्रदर्शन किया गया। यूनियनों के निर्देश पर यह हड़ताल की गई है, क्योंकि सरकार ने पिछले एक साल में कोई सकारात्मक कदम नहीं उठाया।

stories.title: मम्मी से आख़िरी बार बात कराने की गुहार… फोन बंद हुआ, ट्रैक पर कई टुकड़ों में मिला शव
stories.summary: आटा। आटा कस्बे में सोमवार को एक भावुक फोन कॉल ने पूरे परिवार

stories.title: BJP नेताओं ने यौन शोषण पीड़िता को धमकाया, वीडियो वायरल होते ही पुलिस ने लिया एक्शन
stories.summary: मऊ में यौन उत्पीड़न पीड़िता धमकाने के मामले में भाजपा जिलाध्यक्ष समेत तीन भाजपा नेताओं के खिला मुकदमा दर्ज किया गया है। सोशल मीडिया पर धमकाने का वीडियो वायरल होने के बाद पुलिस मुकदमा दर्ज करके जांच में जुटी हुई है।

stories.title: कार्य दिवस पांच दिन करने के लिए बैंक कर्मियों ने की राष्ट्रव्यापी हड़ताल
stories.summary: बस्ती में राष्ट्रीयकृत बैंकों के अधिकारी और कर्मचारी पांच दिवसीय कार्य दिवस की मांग को लेकर हड़ताल पर रहे। सभी बैंक शाखाएं बंद रहीं और उपभोक्ता निराश होकर लौट गए। हड़ताल में एसबीआई, पीएनबी और अन्य बैंक शामिल हैं। कर्मचारी संगठन ने बताया कि इस संबंध में पहले ही प्रबंधन से समझौता हो चुका है।

stories.title: मेरठ : गणतंत्र दिवस परेड में सूर्यास्त्र रॉकेट लॉन्चर सिस्टम के साथ चमकी मेरठ की बेटी लेफ्टिनेंट महक भाटी

stories.title: Minister's Fortuner runs over 3 people, 1 dead:Lalitpur residents claim Manohar Lal’s son showed firearm before escaping the spot
stories.summary: A BJP MLA's Fortuner crushed 3 bike-riding youths in Lalitpur district​​​​​​. One youth died in the accident, while two were injured. On Tuesday morning, angry people surrounded the car and started protesting by blocking the road. Police cleared the jam after persuading them. The accident occurred around 12 midnight on Monday. People allege that the vehicle is registered in the name of Kasturi Devi, wife of UP government's Minister of State Manohar Lal Panth. The minister's son and 4 other people were in the car. All were heavily intoxicated. At the time of the accident, the car's speed was over 100. The car coming from behind hit the bike. The impact was so severe that the car dragged for about 300 meters. Its front part was badly damaged. Parts were scattered on the road. The car's airbags had deployed, so the occupants were not injured. The car was locked. People broke the rear window to get out. When passersby protested about the accident, the minister's son threatened them with a gun and fled, leaving the vehicle behind. See photos related to the incident... The accident occurred in the village Barkheda of Jakhlaun police station area. Shivendra (18 years), son of Raju Yadav, Shankar Singh (45 years), son of Imrat Singh Yadav, and Anuj (20 years), son of Ratibhan Yadav, residents of Barkheda, were returning from the Sundarkand recital. Around 12 midnight on the Lalitpur-Jakhlaun road near Hawra bridge, a Fortuner car (UP 94 AK 9898) hit their bike (UP 94AA 0048) with great force. The collision was so severe that all three youths fell on the road and were seriously injured. The car was going from Jakhlaun towards Lalitpur. Passersby took them to hospital People passing by on the road informed the police, and they themselves took the injured to the district medical college immediately. From there, all three were referred to Jhansi Medical College. However, Shivendra died on the way. The condition of Shankar Singh and Anuj remains critical. Car occupants escaped by breaking rear window The collision was so severe that the Fortuner's airbags deployed. All four doors got locked. After which, all the car occupants broke the rear window to get out. It is alleged that the minister's son was also in the car. When people protested, the minister's son threatened people by showing a gun. Taking advantage of the night, everyone fled. People blocked the road and created ruckus On Tuesday morning, angry villagers blocked the road. When the police tried to take the Fortuner car to the station, the villagers protested and stopped them from taking the car. Upon receiving information about the commotion, Sadar CO Ajay Kumar, Sadar SDM Manish Kumar, Sadar Kotwali in-charge Anurag Awasthi, and Jakhlaun station in-charge Arjun Singh, along with a heavy police force, remained deployed at the spot. The protesting youth said - The car's speed was over 100 at the time of the accident. Those who hit were heavily drunk. They all threatened us and fled from the scene. Police is forcibly taking the car to the station while protecting the accused. The commotion continued for about two hours. After that, the police convinced people by assuring action. The car was taken to the police station. ASP Kalu Singh said- ASP Kalu Singh said - The car involved in the collision is registered in the name of the Minister of State's wife. Investigation is underway to determine who was driving the vehicle. The body has been sent for post-mortem. A case has been registered and further action is being taken.

stories.summary: UGC Boycott Protest : उत्तर प्रदेश की राजनीति में इन दिनों संगठनात्मक गतिविधियों के साथ-साथ आंतरिक असंतोष की खबरें भी सुर्खियों में हैं। भारतीय जनता पार्टी (भाजपा) के स्थानीय स्तर के कुछ पदाधिकारियों द्वारा इस्तीफा दिए जाने के दावों ने जिले से लेकर प्रदेश स्तर तक चर्चा तेज कर दी है। हरदोई और अमेठी से जुड़े ऐसे ही घटनाक्रमों को लेकर राजनीतिक हलकों में कई तरह की व्याख्याए सामने आ रही हैं। हालांकि, इन इस्तीफों और उनसे जुड़े कारणों को लेकर आधिकारिक स्तर पर स्पष्ट पुष्टि अभी सीमित है।

stories.title: मेरठ : राज्य कर विभाग के संवाद में कल मेरठ में जुटेंगे व्यापारी
stories.summary: चौधरी चरण सिंह विवि के अटल सभागार में 28 जनवरी को व्यापारी संवाद कार्यक्रम आयोजित होगा। इसमें व्यापारी, व्यापार मंडल पदाधिकारी और अन्य शामिल होंगे। राज्य कर विभाग व्यापारियों को जीएसटी, पंजीकरण और मुख्यमंत्री व्यापारी दुर्घटना बीमा योजना के बारे में जानकारी देगा।

stories.title: मांग के समर्थन में बैंक कर्मियों ने किया प्रदर्शन
stories.summary: ज्ञानपुर में मंगलवार को बैंक कर्मियों ने फाइव डे बैंकिंग की मांग को लेकर प्रदर्शन किया। बैंक बंद रहे और लोग मायूस होकर लौट गए। बैंक कर्मियों ने कहा कि 15 वर्षों से यह मांग की जा रही है, लेकिन कोई सुनवाई नहीं हो रही। वे हर शनिवार को छुट्टी की मांग कर रहे हैं।

stories.title: GST अफसरों की SIR में लगी ड्यूटी, व्यापारियों के रिफंड दावे अटके
stories.summary: एसआईआर अभियान में राज्य कर विभाग के 32 अधिकारियों की ड्यूटी लगी है, जिससे व्यापारियों के रिफंड दावों का निस्तारण नहीं हो पा रहा है। पिछले 60 दिनों के आईटीसी क्लेम दावों का निस्तारण हो चुका है, लेकिन बाकी दावों का निस्तारण अगले महीने ही संभव होगा। व्यापारियों ने वैकल्पिक व्यवस्था की मांग की है।

stories.title: यातायात दरोगा को किन्नर ने जड़ा तमाचा
stories.summary: पीडीडीयू नगर के मुगलसराय कोतवाली क्षेत्र में एक किन्नर ने यातायात दरोगा को थप्पड़ मार दिया। यह घटना रविवार रात को हुई। पुलिस ने किन्नर के खिलाफ मामला दर्ज कर उसकी तलाश शुरू कर दी है। किन्नर नशे में था और घटना के बाद अपने साथियों के साथ भाग गया।

stories.title: UP News: 'आप दंगा कराना चाहते हैं, हर बार करते हैं ड्रामा'; चंदौली में सीओ और सपा विधायक के बीच तू-तू मैं मैं
stories.summary: सीओ देवेंद्र कुमार ने पूर्व सपा विधायक मनोज सिंह डब्लू को कहा कि आप दंगा कराना चाहते हैं और हर बार इसी तरीके से ड्रामा करते हैं।

stories.title: भोट में मिले प्रतिबंधित पशुओं के अवशेष, हंगामा
stories.summary: भोट थाना क्षेत्र में प्रतिबंधित पशुओं के अवशेष मिलने से हंगामा मच गया। हिन्दू संगठनों के कार्यकर्ताओं ने आरोपियों की गिरफ्तारी की मांग की। पुलिस ने मौके पर आकर सैंपल लिए और जल्द गिरफ्तारी का आश्वासन दिया। इस मामले में भोट थाने में अज्ञात के खिलाफ रिपोर्ट दर्ज की गई है।

stories.title: दोहरे मापदंडो पर..., अब ब्रजभूषण सिंह के बेटे विधायक प्रतीक भूषण ने UGC एक्ट के खिलाफ खोला मोर्चा

stories.title: बिलासपुर में जमीन विवाद में बड़े भाई को गोली से उड़ाया, कोहराम
stories.summary: बिलासपुर कोतवाली क्षेत्र में भूमि बंटवारे को लेकर छोटे भाई नवनीत सिंह ने बड़े भाई हरमीत सिंह की गोली मारकर हत्या कर दी। दोनों भाइयों में विवाद काफी समय से चल रहा था। पुलिस ने शव को पोस्टमार्टम के लिए भेज दिया है और आगे की विधिक कार्रवाई की जा रही है।

stories.title: मांगों को लेकर बैंक कर्मियों का प्रदर्शन, ग्राहक परेशान
stories.summary: पीडीडीयू नगर (चंदौली) में बैंक कर्मचारियों ने विभिन्न मांगों को लेकर विरोध प्रदर्शन किया। उन्होंने सप्ताह में पांच दिन काम करने की मांग की, जो लंबे समय से लंबित है। बैंक बंद होने के कारण ग्राहक मायूस होकर लौट गए और बैंकिंग कार्य प्रभावित हुआ। कर्मचारी चाहते हैं कि हर शनिवार को बैंक बंद रहें।

stories.title: School teacher held for raising slogans in support of Jinnah during Republic Day event in Bihar
stories.summary: A purported video of the incident went viral on social media, in which students are seen responding "amar rahe (long live)" to the call "Jinnah" by the accused teacher.

stories.title: CRPF jawan among four dead in road crash in Jammu and Kashmir’s Udhampur

stories.title: कलक्ट्रेट में ध्वजारोहण के साथ रंगारंग कार्यक्रमों की धूम
stories.summary: कलेक्ट्रेट में ध्वजारोहण कार्यक्रम का आयोजन किया गया, जिसमें जिलाधिकारी अनुज सिंह ने ध्वज फहराया। कार्यक्रम में सभी एडीएम, एसडीएम और कलेक्ट्रेट स्टाफ मौजूद थे। जिलाधिकारी ने स्वतंत्रता और संविधान के महत्व पर भी प्रकाश डाला। जनगणमन के साथ समारोह का समापन हुआ।

stories.title: यूजीसी प्रोविजन को खत्म करे सरकार : पंडित नवीन शर्मा
stories.summary: राष्ट्रवादी ब्राह्मण मंच के अध्यक्ष पंडित नवीन शर्मा ने सवर्णों के खिलाफ मौजूदा यूजीसी प्रोविजन को काला कानून बताया। उन्होंने कहा कि इससे समाज में विभाजन और वैमनस्य बढ़ेगा। शर्मा ने यह भी कहा कि सवर्णों के साथ भेदभाव के मामलों में वृद्धि हुई है और सभी जातियों के बुद्धिजीवी इस बिल के विरोध में खड़े हुए हैं।

stories.title: शान से लहराया तिरंगा, गूंजा जनगण मन
stories.summary: गणतंत्र दिवस पर मुरादाबाद के सरकारी दफ्तरों में सुबह साढ़े आठ बजे ध्वजारोहण किया गया। मंडलायुक्त आन्जनेय कुमार सिंह ने झंडा फहराते हुए देश की प्रगति और स्वतंत्रता संग्राम सेनानियों के योगदान पर प्रकाश डाला। उन्होंने नागरिकों के कर्तव्यों पर भी जोर दिया और ईमानदारी से जिम्मेदारियों का निर्वाहन करने की अपील की।

stories.title: बढ़ा मुरादाबाद का गौरव....झोली में पद्मश्री
stories.summary: मुरादाबाद के दस्तकार चिरंजी लाल और किसान रघुपत सिंह को पद्मश्री पुरस्कार से सम्मानित किया गया है। चिरंजी लाल को मेटल नक्काशी के लिए और रघुपत सिंह को कृषि नवाचार के लिए यह सम्मान दिया गया है। रघुपत सिंह को मरणोपरांत यह पुरस्कार मिलेगा। मुरादाबाद में अब चार पद्मश्री हो गए हैं।

stories.title: ट्रेन की चपेट में आकर अज्ञात अधेड़ की मौत
stories.summary: नियामताबाद(चंदौली) में अज्ञात 45 वर्षीय अधेड़ का शव सोमवार सुबह रेलवे ट्रैक पर मिला। ग्रामीणों ने पुलिस को सूचना दी। पुलिस ने शव को कब्जे में लेकर शिनाख्त की कोशिश की, लेकिन पहचान नहीं हो सकी। थाना प्रभारी ने बताया कि अधेड़ संभवतः ट्रेन से गिरकर मरा है। जांच जारी है।

stories.title: पद्मश्री से मुरादाबाद का नाम और ऊंचा...
stories.summary: अखिल भारतीय हस्तशिल्प बोर्ड के पूर्व सदस्य और ब्रास कारखानेदार एसोसिएशन के अध्यक्ष आजम अंसारी ने कहा कि मुरादाबाद को तीसरा पद्मश्री मिलना गर्व की बात है। उन्होंने प्रधानमंत्री मोदी से बातचीत में कहा कि यह अवार्ड अंतिम पंक्ति के व्यक्ति को मिला है, जिससे उम्मीद है कि मुरादाबाद को भविष्य में पद्मभूषण और पद्मविभूषण भी मिलेंगे।

stories.title: मेरठ : क्रिकेट मुकाबले में खूब लगे चौके-छक्के
stories.summary: गेम सिटी एरीना द्वारा आयोजित गट्स एंड ग्लोरी कॉरपोरेट क्रिकेट टूर्नामेंट में जी.बी. ब्लब ने इनविंसिबल वॉरियर्स को हराया। जी.बी. ब्लब ने 292 रन बनाए, जबकि इनविंसिबल वॉरियर्स ने 194 रन बनाकर मैच हार गया। मयंक को उनके शानदार प्रदर्शन के लिए मैन ऑफ द मैच घोषित किया गया।

stories.title: घर के भीतर फंदे से लटकता मिला किशोरी का शव
stories.summary: आजमगढ़ के फूलपुर कोतवाली क्षेत्र के विशेखा गांव में एक 16 वर्षीय किशोरी सानिया का शव घर के भीतर फंदे से लटकता मिला। परिवार द्वारा दरवाजा तोड़ने पर शव मिला। इस घटना की सूचना पुलिस को दी गई, जिसने शव को पोस्टमार्टम के लिए भेज दिया।

stories.title: राजनैतिक दलों ने फहराया तिरंगा, शहीदों को किया नमन
stories.summary: आजमगढ़ में गणतंत्र दिवस के अवसर पर भाजपा, कांग्रेस, सपा सहित अन्य राजनीतिक दलों ने ध्वजारोहण किया। सभी ने स्वतंत्रता सेनानियों को श्रद्धांजलि दी। भाजपा जिलाध्यक्ष ध्रुव कुमार सिंह ने तिरंगा फहराया और शहीदों की वीरता पर प्रकाश डाला। कांग्रेस अध्यक्ष ने कहा कि संविधान सभी को समान अधिकार देता है।

stories.title: मेरठ : लखनऊ में सपा प्रमुख अखिलेश यादव से मिले पार्टी नेता
stories.summary: लखनऊ में सपा विधायक अतुल प्रधान के नेतृत्व में मेरठ के सपा नेताओं ने अखिलेश यादव से मुलाकात की। इस दौरान उन्होंने डॉक्टर भीमराव आंबेडकर का चित्र भेंट किया और संगठन की मजबूती पर चर्चा की। यादव ने 2027 के मिशन को सफल बनाने के लिए एकजुट होकर काम करने का आह्वान किया।

stories.title: करेली में 65 वर्षीय वृद्ध महिला के साथ घर में घुसकर दुष्कर्म
stories.summary: पीलीभीत के बिलसंडा क्षेत्र में एक 65 वर्षीय वृद्ध महिला के साथ दुष्कर्म का मामला सामने आया है। घटना के समय महिला अकेली थी क्योंकि उसके पति किसी काम से बाहर गए थे। आरोपी बलविंदर सिंह ने महिला के साथ दुष्कर्म किया और फरार हो गया। पुलिस ने मामला दर्ज कर लिया है और आरोपी की तलाश जारी है।

stories.title: Kinnar Akhada expels Mamta Kulkarni:Former actress had raised questions on Avimukteshwaranand controversy, said, '90% Shankaracharyas fake'
stories.summary: Dr. Lakshmi Narayan Tripathi, chief of the Kinnar Akhada, confirmed in a released video that Mahamandaleshwar Mamta Kulkarni has been expelled. He said the decision was made after consulting Akhada officials. “Mamta Kulkarni no longer has any connection with the Akhada. She is neither an officer nor a member. Our Akhada includes women, men, and transgenders, and we do not want any controversy,” he added. Dr. Tripathi also expressed anger over the beating of Batuk Brahmins, whose sikhas (hair tufts) were pulled, on the day of Mauni Amavasya. On January 25, Mamta Kulkarni (Yamai Mamta Nand Giri) had questioned Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand on two points: Who appointed him as Shankaracharya, and why did he move through a crowd of millions in a chariot (palanquin)? Mamta Kulkarni alleged that Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand’s actions led to his disciples being beaten. She said that if they wanted to bathe, they could have simply walked down from the palanquin. “Being a guru means acting responsibly, not forcing disciples to suffer for one’s stubbornness,” she added. Questioning SP chief Akhilesh Yadav, Mamta asked whether he could guarantee an end to cow slaughter. Referring to a dialogue between Rishi Kunal and Shwetketu in the Rigveda, she stressed that religion should remain separate from politics. Praised PM Modi and Priyanka Actually, in a conversation with the IANS news agency, Mamata Kulkarni praised PM Modi. She said - Currently, there seems to be no alternative to PM Narendra Modi, and Modi will continue ahead. Look at the situation, when PM Modi is there, nothing wrong is happening anywhere. If anyone feels something is wrong, please tell. We are doing everything peacefully. No one has any problem. She said - These people, meaning Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand ji, are leaning towards the Samajwadi Party because they have only one issue. Cows should not be slaughtered. So will these questions be solved by going with Akhilesh Yadav? Avimukteshwaranand has a lot of ego Mamata Kulkarni said - Whether king or pauper, everyone has to follow the law and no one should have ego. One does not become Shankaracharya just by memorizing four Vedas. He (Avimukteshwaranand) has a lot of ego and zero self-knowledge. So-called Shankaracharya is false Mamta Kulkarni launched a major attack on Mahamandleshwars. She said, nine out of ten Mahamandleshwars and so-called Shankaracharyas are fake and have zero knowledge. She claimed that her guru belonged to the Nath sect and was an ascetic saint. Mamta Kulkarni also made it clear that she will not return to Bollywood in this lifetime, and she wants to be free from the position of Mahamandleshwar. In the end, she advised Mamata Banerjee not to take extreme positions on any issue. Akhilesh had talked with Shankaracharya SP chief Akhilesh Yadav had spoken to Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand. He had expressed grief over the assault with disciples. Akhilesh had said - BJP is on the path of unrighteousness. Stopping Shankaracharya and saints from taking a holy dip in the Ganges is the biggest unrighteousness. He said that Shankaracharya should be given full respect. Saints from across the country and people of Sanatan Dharma are standing in his support. He alleged that the government is pressuring officials to send notices to Shankaracharya. Akhilesh said that if the government insults any saint-sage or Shankaracharya, the Samajwadi Party will stand against it. He said that the BJP government is asking for a certificate from Shankaracharya. If someone asks the Chief Minister for proof of being a Yogi, will they give it? What proof do they have of being a Yogi? Was in headlines during Mahakumbh Mamata suddenly arrived at the Prayagraj Mahakumbh on January 23, 2025. In the afternoon, she met with Kinnar Akhada's Acharya Mahamandaleshwar Lakshmi Narayan Tripathi. They had a long discussion. Then both met with Akhada Parishad's National President Ravindra Puri, and Mamata was made a Mahamandaleshwar. She was given the name Yamai Mamata Nand Giri. Pandit Dhirendra Krishna Shastri, Yoga Guru Baba Ramdev, and several other saints had opposed this. Ramdev had said - one cannot attain sainthood in a day. After this, on February 10, Mamata resigned from the position of Kinnar Akhada's Mahamandaleshwar. However, 2 days later, on February 12, she withdrew her resignation. Mamta remained in controversies, did topless photoshoot for magazine Mamta, who shared screen with big stars like Shah Rukh Khan, Salman Khan, Ajay Devgn, and Anil Kapoor, came into controversy when she did a topless photoshoot for Stardust magazine in 1993. Meanwhile, director Rajkumar Santoshi had cast Mamta as the lead actress in the film 'China Gate'. After initial disagreements, Santoshi wanted to remove Mamta from the film. According to reports, she was kept in the film after pressure from the underworld increased. However, the film proved to be a flop, and later, Mamta also accused Santoshi of sexual harassment. Married drug mafia, became a sadhvi Mamta was accused of marrying Dubai-based underworld drug mafia Vicky Goswami. However, Mamta always called her marriage news a rumour. Mamta said that I never married anyone. It is true that I love Vicky, but he would also know that now my first love is God. Mamta released her book 'Autobiography of a Yogini' in 2013. During this time, explaining the reason for saying goodbye to the film world, she said, 'Some people are born for worldly work, while some are born for God. I, too, was born for God.'

stories.title: Slogans raised in Lucknow demanding UGC rollback:LU students took to streets; warn of rising caste tensions on campus
stories.summary: Protests against the new rules of the University Grants Commission (UGC) have intensified in Lucknow. Students from many colleges, including Lucknow University, have taken to the streets. Strong demonstrations are ongoing outside the LU campus. Students are raising slogans against the UGC Act of 2026. They are demanding a UGC rollback. Students say this is UGC's black law. Until the government withdraws it, we will not back down. Student Arpit Tiwari said - Through UGC, there is an attempt to victimize SC/ST students. This is an attempt to directly declare general category students as criminals. Student Akarsh Mishra said - UGC's new rules will increase caste conflict on campus. He concluded his statement with the poetic lines - 'The battle is not over, the hunter is not the only bearer of sin, those who remain neutral, time will record their crimes too.' In view of the violent protests by students, a heavy police force has been deployed on campus by the LU administration. All gates including LU's main gate Bhaurao Deoras Gate have been closed. Student entry has been banned on campus for some time. The proctor and administrative officers are present at the scene. Why oppose UGC's new rules? UGC notified its new rules on January 13. It is called - 'Promotion of Equity in Higher Education Institutions Regulations, 2026.' Under this, instructions have been given to form special committees, helplines, and monitoring teams to prevent caste-based discrimination in colleges and universities. These teams will specifically look into complaints from SC, ST, and OBC students. The government says these changes have been made to bring fairness and accountability in higher education institutions. However, the rules are being opposed by calling them against the general category. Critics say that upper-caste students have been made 'natural criminals'. General category students say that the new rules could promote discrimination against them on college or university campuses. This will create chaos in colleges.

stories.title: Ayodhya GST Deputy Commissioner resigns in support of CM Yogi:Prashant Singh says, 'Won't tolerate CM's insult, Shankaracharya’s comments crossed the line'
stories.summary: The controversy of Shankaracharya in UP is now growing. Now, Ayodhya's GST Deputy Commissioner Prashant Kumar Singh has resigned in support of PM Modi, Home Minister Amit Shah, and CM Yogi. He said that he felt very bad about Shankaracharya's comments on the CM. I am hurt by this. I can no longer tolerate the insult of the Chief Minister. He said- I eat the salt and bread of the state, my family runs on the state's salary. If unparliamentary words are used against the head of that state, I will feel the pain. I too have a heart and sensitiveness. Because I am bound by UP Employee Rules. I couldn't bear this pain for two days, so I sent my resignation to the Governor." Earlier on Monday, the City Magistrate Alankar Agnihotri of Bareilly had also resigned. The reason given was UGC's new law and the beating of Avimukteshwaranand's disciples. 'Cannot speak disrespectfully to CM while sitting on a handcart' The GST Deputy Commissioner said - I will continue my government work until my resignation is accepted. After the resignation is accepted, I will work for society with whatever means I have. Today, I am expressing the pain that I feel. The Constitution has defined ways to protest, but you cannot speak disrespectfully to the Chief Minister while sitting on a handcart. He is our provider. All I want to say is that you should be careful of such people. They create a wrong atmosphere in society. They divide society. I oppose such statements because they cause society to divide into castes. Know what has happened so far in the Avimukteshwaranand controversy

stories.title: 3 BJP leaders booked for intimidating rape survivor in Mau:Accused of pressuring her for compromise and offering money
stories.summary: A case was registered on Monday in Mau against three BJP leaders, including the party’s district vice-president, for allegedly intimidating a rape victim and pressuring her to compromise. The leaders had visited the victim’s house, where a video later surfaced showing them discussing a settlement. The victim alleged that the BJP leaders also offered money for a compromise and said she would not settle under any circumstances, insisting that the accused Ankit should either marry her or go to jail. Police have arrested the accused and registered an FIR against BJP district vice-president Santosh Kumar Singh alias Pannu, along with Kanhaiya Tiwari and Himanshu Rai. Case details Affair for 3 years, backed out on marriage Woman made a video of BJP leaders The victim alleges that after Ankit Singh went to jail, some local BJP leaders reached her house and started pressuring her to withdraw the case and compromise. During this, the victim made a video of the entire incident, which later went viral on social media. After the video surfaced, political activity in the district intensified. Based on the victim's complaint and the video, the police have registered a case against three BJP leaders under relevant sections. The accused include District Vice President Santosh Kumar Singh alias Pannu, Kanhaiya Tiwari, and Himanshu Rai. Additional Superintendent of Police Anoop Kumar said, When the victim was working on contract in the DUDA department, her colleague Ankit Singh had physical relations with her by promising marriage. A case was registered in this regard and the accused was sent to jail. Another complaint has now been filed by the victim, alleging that three people pressured her for a compromise. Police have registered a case in this matter and further legal action will be taken based on the evidence.

stories.title: Illegal Madrasas operating as schools on UP-Nepal border:Over 500 reopen after crackdown; sting reveals foreign funding, donations flowing through overseas links, networks
stories.summary: More than 500 madrasas that were declared illegal and shut down by the Uttar Pradesh government last year have quietly resumed operations along the sensitive UP–Nepal border region. An in-depth investigation has revealed that many of these institutions are now functioning under the cover of “private schools,” while continuing religious education without proper recognition or approval. The reopening of these Madrasas has raised serious concerns among security agencies and the local administration, especially after evidence surfaced showing that several of them are receiving foreign funds in the name of religious donations, particularly Zakat. The investigation shows how weak monitoring, legal loopholes, and local pressure have allowed these institutions to restart despite official orders. Massive crackdown in 2023 Between April and June 2023, the Uttar Pradesh government launched a large-scale crackdown on illegal madrasas operating near the UP–Nepal border. The action followed intelligence inputs and administrative surveys that flagged these institutions for running without registration, occupying government or Gram Sabha land, and lacking transparency in funding. During the operation, 542 Madrasas were sealed or demolished across districts like Siddharthnagar, Maharajganj, Shravasti, Balrampur, and Bahraich. Bulldozers were used at several locations where illegal construction was confirmed. Officials at the time said the action was necessary due to the sensitive nature of the border area and the lack of records regarding students, teachers, and funding sources. However, barely six to seven months later, many of these madrasas have resumed classes. How the Madrasas are reopening The investigation found that madrasa operators are using multiple methods to restart operations: While officially claiming to teach subjects like Hindi, English, Math, Science, and Geography, religious instruction continues alongside. Dhanora Buzurg: Madrasa running again In Dhanora Buzurg village of Siddharthnagar district, the madrasa Nurul Islam was found operating openly. Two teachers were seen teaching young children. A local resident, Abdul Ali, said, When the administration took action, the madrasa was closed. Later, officials told us we could reopen after completing paperwork. That is why it is still running. He added that the madrasa building is old and teachers come from nearby villages. At the village mosque, Karam Hussain, the muazzin, confirmed that funds are received from abroad, Many people from our village live in Saudi Arabia. They send money to their families, and the families give Zakat to the Madrasa. He further said, The Madrasa does not have recognition yet, but it will get it. We were given one year’s time. Foreign funding admitted on camera During the investigation, villagers and madrasa staff openly admitted that donations come from relatives working overseas. Karam Hussain said, Teachers are paid from donations and Zakat. Money comes through families whose relatives are in Saudi Arabia. He also claimed: SSB officers come to check what is being taught. We tell them we teach science and geography too. Hindu children also study here. Malgahia Village: Madrasa rebuilt elsewhere In Malgahia village, a large madrasa building near the mosque had been demolished during the government drive. Locals said hundreds of children studied there earlier. Now, classes are being held in another house. Madrasa manager Abdul Rashid said, The Madrasa was built on agricultural land. Later it was declared illegal and demolished. We had no place to teach, so we are trying to restart it elsewhere. Principal Maqbool Ahmed added, Our elders started this Madrasa in 1962, but it was never registered. That is why it was demolished. Now we are applying for school recognition. A local resident, Irshad Ahmed, leased his house for Madrasa use, I gave my house for 25 years at ₹1,000. Running a madrasa brings reward (Sawaab). Parsa Diwan: Madrasa runs despite closure In Parsa Diwan village, residents initially claimed that the madrasa had been shut. However, hidden-camera footage showed that classes were still being conducted. Teacher Maqsood Alam said, The Madrasa runs on village donations. Recognition has been stopped, so we don’t have it. He added that the madrasa operators live in Mumbai and teachers come from nearby villages. Shivbhari village: Demolition on Gram Sabha land In Shivbhari, a madrasa and mosque built on Gram Sabha land were demolished. Local resident Naseem said, Our land was wrongly recorded as wasteland. Because of this, the Madrasa was demolished. Before demolition, the madrasa had around 120 students. After closure, many children were enrolled in government schools, but parents complained about distance and lack of religious education. Villager Mujammil said, Poor families cannot send children far away. Their education has suffered. Dhanori village: Classes continue In Dhanori village, officials had earlier ordered the madrasa to obtain recognition. Despite this, classes continue six days a week. Teacher Ghulam Waris said, Officials visited 6–7 months ago and asked us to complete recognition. The process is ongoing. Sonauli border area: Court orders cited At the Sonauli border, 14 madrasas were shut during the drive. In Hardi Dali village, residents said the madrasa was sealed but later reopened. A villager, Ramzan, said, We were allowed to operate again through court orders. We are applying for school recognition and teaching other subjects as well. Mujhana milik: Large Madrasa still closed In Mujhana Milik village, a madrasa that once had 250 students remains closed. Teacher Fajre Alam said: We have filed a case in the High Court. If reopened, we will teach Hindi and English along with religious education. Why recognition is a major issue For years, recognition of madrasas in Uttar Pradesh has been stalled due to policy changes and legal challenges. As a result, many institutions continue without approval. Under education rules: However, many madrasa operators are now seeking school recognition to continue religious teaching indirectly. Government schools rejected by parents Many Muslim families prefer madrasa education because government schools do not provide religious instruction. Parents told investigators that: This demand keeps illegal madrasas running despite official bans. Officials warn of strict action Officials have made it clear that misuse of school recognition will not be allowed. Siddharthnagar District Inspector of Schools Arun Kumar said, Schools cannot teach religious subjects. If they do, recognition will be canceled. Maharajganj DIOS Pradeep Kumar Sharma said, Recognition will be given strictly as per rules. Religious education is not allowed in schools. Siddharthnagar SDM Vivekanand Mishra said: No Madrasa can run without recognition. If found, action will be taken. Nautanwa SDM Naveen Prasad added, Some institutions reopened due to court orders. Others operating illegally will face strict action.

stories.title: Uma Bharti backs Shankaracharya, slams administration for seeking proof:Avimukteshwaranand responds, she should convey this message to Yogi; officer resigns in support CM
stories.summary: The standoff between Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand and the Magh Mela administration has emerged as a serious problem for the government. BJP firebrand leader Uma Bharti has publicly backed Avimukteshwaranand, saying the administration crossed the limits of propriety by demanding proof from the Shankaracharya. Responding to her remarks, Avimukteshwaranand said she should convey the same message to Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath. Blood letter sent to CM Yogi Dinesh Phalahari Baba, the main petitioner in the Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi temple case, has written a letter in blood to Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath. He demanded that arrangements be made for Avimukteshwaranand to perform a Ganga bath with due respect. He also urged the Chief Minister to instruct officials to issue an apology. Dispute reaches bureaucracy The 10-day-long confrontation has now reached the bureaucracy. In Ayodhya, GST Deputy Commissioner Prashant Kumar Singh resigned in support of Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath. He said he was hurt by the abusive language allegedly used by Avimukteshwaranand against the Chief Minister and could no longer tolerate the insult. Calls for ban and NSA Meanwhile, Paramhans Maharaj of Ayodhya Cantonment Dham alleged that Avimukteshwaranand and Satua Baba had defamed the Magh Mela. He demanded that both be banned from entering the Magh Mela and called for the National Security Act (NSA) to be imposed on Avimukteshwaranand. City Magistrate’s resignation and strong remarks On Monday, Bareilly City Magistrate Alankar Agnihotri resigned in support of Avimukteshwaranand. Since then, the Shankaracharya has intensified his attacks on the government, saying the present battle was not between Hindus and Muslims or between the British and Indians, but between fake and real Hindus. What has happened so far ? On 18 January, Avimukteshwaranand was heading for a Mauni Amavasya bath in a palanquin when police stopped him and asked him to proceed on foot, leading to a scuffle with his disciples. The administration later issued two notices, questioning the use of the Shankaracharya title and the Mauni Amavasya disturbance, warning of a possible ban. After a Bareilly magistrate resigned on 26 January, his resignation was rejected, he was suspended, and an inquiry was ordered.

stories.title: Nathu La 1967, 4 soldiers and 1 officer:UP’s Attar Singh leads surviving jawans to halt Chinese assault, defends India’s pride
stories.summary: ‘UP ke Yoddha’ today tells the story of a soldier whose resolve held firm when an Indian post stood on the brink of collapse. During the 1967 Indo-China conflict, a forward post came under a sudden and intense enemy assault. Most soldiers stationed there were either killed or seriously wounded. Even in those conditions, 24-year-old Second Lieutenant Attar Singh refused to withdraw. With only four soldiers remaining, he held the position and stopped the enemy from advancing. For this act of leadership under fire, he received a rare field promotion to Captain. Attar Singh later played a key role in the 1971 war with Pakistan, where he was entrusted with sustaining Indian troops deep inside hostile desert terrain. Across both wars, his conduct became a lesson in composure, judgement and responsibility. But the defining chapter began in 1967. First posting on a tense frontier Attar Singh joined the Army as a soldier and was commissioned as a Second Lieutenant in the Grenadiers Regiment in 1967. His first posting was along the India-China border near Nathu La Pass. Even five years after the 1962 war, conditions on the frontier remained fragile. Chinese and Indian posts were separated by barely 50 yards. Soldiers faced each other daily, and confrontation was constant. On August 15, 1967, Attar Singh reported to his Company Commander, Captain Prithvi Singh Dagar. Assessing the young officer, Captain Dagar remarked that he was glad to have someone who could stand firm when required. Within days, Chinese soldiers began repeatedly crossing into Indian-held areas. Protests were met with intimidation. Army Headquarters ordered the installation of fencing to block further movement. Attar Singh assembled his platoon and began preparations. Border clashes and the fencing order As fencing work began, Chinese soldiers intervened, issuing threats and attempting to stop the activity. Verbal arguments quickly turned physical. Over the next two days, eight to nine such clashes took place. Captain Dagar reported the developments to higher command. The response was direct: reinforce the position and strengthen the fencing. Additional troops were rushed in. By evening, Indian strength at Nathu La had risen to nearly 350 soldiers under seven officers. Orders were issued to resume fencing at first light without hesitation. September 11, 1967: the battle at Nathu La At dawn, Indian soldiers took up their positions and resumed work. A small group of Chinese troops approached, signalling talks. Attar Singh warned that the gesture could not be trusted. Moments later, another Chinese unit emerged from cover and opened fire without warning. Machine guns, rifles and mortars were brought into action. The hills of Nathu La echoed with gunfire. What had begun as a confrontation turned into open battle. Indian troops were operating under restrictive orders. Heavy weapons required clearance from higher command. Despite determined resistance, casualties mounted rapidly. Two company commanders, including Captain Dagar, four Subedars and 83 soldiers were killed. Around 190 were seriously wounded. By late morning, Attar Singh was the senior surviving officer. Alone in command Radio communication had collapsed. Key weapon crews were injured. The cries of wounded soldiers filled the area. All of this unfolded within a range of 800–900 yards. Attar Singh now carried the full responsibility of the post. He had to ensure the evacuation of the wounded while preventing any enemy advance. By 11 am, only four soldiers remained with him. Realising the danger of exposure, Attar Singh devised a simple but effective tactic. He ordered the soldiers to fire from one position and immediately shift to another, repeating the process continuously. The objective was clear: the enemy must believe that Indian strength remained intact. The plan worked. Chinese troops hesitated, uncertain of the numbers facing them. Permission that changed the battle At around 2 pm, a signal line was partially restored. Attar Singh contacted Brigadier Ray Singh Yadav and briefed him on the situation. The instruction was firm: the post was not to be abandoned. Soon after, Major General Sagat Singh intervened and authorised artillery fire, accepting full responsibility for the decision. Indian guns opened up. The enemy’s forward positions collapsed. Chinese forces suffered heavy losses, estimated at around 450 killed, and withdrew from the area. The battle marked a decisive shift and restored confidence lost in 1962. The next morning, Attar Singh was summoned. In recognition of his conduct, he was promoted directly to Captain—an advancement that normally takes several years. The 1971 war: leadership in the desert During the 1971 war with Pakistan, Captain Attar Singh was posted to Rajasthan’s Barmer sector. The terrain offered no roads, little water and extreme conditions. He was assigned a critical logistical role: delivering food, water and ammunition to Indian troops advancing inside Pakistani territory. With the Army’s focus on Punjab and East Pakistan, the Rajasthan front posed unique challenges. Using old railway tracks as guides, Attar Singh led a convoy of 16 vehicles across shifting sand. Iron sheets were placed under tyres to prevent vehicles from sinking. After 28 hours of continuous effort, supplies reached the front, eight kilometres across open desert. When informed that a platoon had gone without food and water for two days, Attar Singh immediately diverted camel-borne supplies to their position. Life at the front Conditions were severe. Soldiers were rationed one litre of water per day. Bathing was rare. Water was reused for washing clothes. Even so, operations continued. Indian forces advanced nearly 78 kilometres inside Pakistan, holding their ground through discipline and planning. When an entire platoon came close to destruction One night, while moving without lights in enemy territory, Attar Singh noticed movement ahead and ordered the convoy to halt. Moments later, an order to fire tank shells at close range was heard. Recognising the voice, Attar Singh called out to Major R.D. Law, his former instructor at the Indian Military Academy. The firing order was cancelled instantly. Eight tanks stood ready. Seconds more would have meant the destruction of the entire convoy. Presence of mind and recognition saved the platoon. A soldier’s career After 32 years of service, Attar Singh retired in 1992 with the rank of Colonel. stories.summary: Weather conditions may change again across Uttar Pradesh on Tuesday. The Meteorological Department has issued a hail alert for 14 districts and a thunderstorm alert for 50 districts. Officials say that if hail occurs, temperatures could drop by 3–4 degrees Celsius. Most districts began the day with clear skies, but strong winds continue to intensify the chill. People were seen gathering around bonfires in several areas to cope with the cold. Muzaffarnagar remained the coldest district in the state, recording a minimum temperature of 5.1 degrees Celsius. Meteorologist Atul Kumar Singh said that due to the impact of a western disturbance, parts of western UP may receive rain today, with wind speeds reaching 30–40 kmph at some locations. See the weather pictures - Now know the conditions of big cities New disturbance will be active after 3 days The Meteorological Department said the influence of westerly winds continues across North India. Wind circulation remains active over Haryana and adjoining regions, while a strong westerly jet stream is flowing at higher altitudes. stories.title: Brij Bhushan confirms bid for 2029 Lok Sabha polls:BJP leader alleges ‘international conspiracy’ behind wrestlers’ allegations, backs Vinay Katiyar’s first claim on Ayodhya
stories.summary: BJP senior leader and six-time MP Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh has said that the Rashtra Katha was organised to unite different castes of society and link the ideals of Lord Ram with freedom fighters such as Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose and Chandrashekhar Azad. Alleging an international conspiracy involving Khalistani elements and the Congress behind the women wrestlers’ case, he said he would definitely contest the 2029 Lok Sabha elections, with the party deciding the seat. He made these remarks in a special conversation with Bhaskar Digital, during which he also spoke on Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, Akhilesh Yadav, Pankaj Chaudhary and future politics... Question: Will you contest from Ayodhya? Vinay Katiyar has also spoken about contesting from there. Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh: No. I recently went to Barabanki, where I was asked the same question. I want to say clearly through your platform that Vinay Katiyar has the first right over the Ayodhya Lok Sabha seat. He should contest, and I welcome that. Question: You have said you want to go to the Lok Sabha once more. Why? Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh: I do not wish to be woven into a maiden’s jewellery. I have been an MP six times. My wife was once an MP, my son is an MP, and many associates have become MLAs and MPs. I have no such personal ambition. However, I believe there was a conspiracy against me in 2023–24. Because of that, I said I would like to return to the Lok Sabha. I am saying it again today. I will contest in 2029. The seat will be decided later. Question: Which seat will you contest from? Your son is an MP from Kaiserganj. Are you looking at another seat? Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh: The party knows everything. The party will decide from where I should contest. Question: What if the party says your son should contest again? Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh: I want to go to the Lok Sabha once, by any means. Question: Who was behind the allegations made by women wrestlers in 2023? Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh: This was a worldwide conspiracy. I said then that I would come out unblemished, and I am saying it again today. Congress leaders were the most visible at the protest sites. Priyanka Gandhi, Ashok Gehlot and Bhupinder Hooda were involved. But it was not limited to them. Many others tried to take advantage of the situation. Some people from our own side were also involved. There was support from Khalistani elements as well. Banners and posters were put up even in the United States. Question: You were facing serious allegations. How much support did you get from the party? Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh: What crisis? Allegations alone do not create a crisis. My party gave me full support. Question: Meetings of MLAs from specific communities were held in Lucknow. How do you see this? Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh: Such meetings should happen. Similar meetings also take place inside Parliament. Representatives from all parties belonging to a particular community attend them. They discuss issues and convey them to their respective parties. There is nothing wrong in people from the same community meeting and sharing concerns. The problem arises only if they come out and speak against the party. In my view, issuing a notice over such meetings was wrong. Question: BJP suffered setbacks in 2024. What does your experience say about 2027? Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh: It is too early to say. Elections are still far away. As of now, BJP appears strong. Question: There has been discussion about your relationship with Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath. Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh: Our relationship was never bad. There was a phase when we did not meet. When he called, I went. We have known each other since childhood. When Gurudev Avaidyanath Maharaj was alive, I used to visit the temple regularly. He never treated me any differently from Yogi ji. Question: What are your views on SIR, as many names have reportedly been removed? Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh: This is a serious issue. People should show patience. It needs proper study. Some matters are before the Supreme Court. There is pressure on us to comment, but until I am clear about what is right and wrong, I do not think it is appropriate to speak. Question: Have you met BJP president Pankaj Chaudhary? Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh: Not yet. He has been travelling extensively, and I was busy with religious discourse. We spoke over the phone. He has been attending our katha for 25 years. The party has made him president after due consideration. We were elected to the Lok Sabha together in 1991. Today, he is a Union minister. His appointment will benefit the party. Question: Were you invited to the Ayodhya temple consecration ceremony? Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh: When I was not invited, I did not go. When I was invited, I attended. Question: What was the objective behind organising Rashtra Katha? Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh: Hindu society is divided into many castes. Over time, divisions have deepened. Through Rashtra Katha, the aim was to bring everyone together. The event was inaugurated by 52 religious leaders from different castes. It was not organised for personal publicity. The story included Ram, Hanuman, Subhas Chandra Bose and Chandrashekhar Azad. It addressed national issues and created awareness among students and society. Question: Akhilesh Yadav often praises you and even offered you a ticket in 2024. Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh: I also praise Akhilesh. He is a good person. We share an old relationship. We respected Mulayam Singh Yadav’s working style, even when political relations were strained. Question: What do you think about Akhilesh Yadav’s PDA slogan? Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh: That is his agenda. I have nothing to do with it. Question: Do you watch films? Have you watched Border 2? Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh: I watch films regularly. I have not watched Border 2 yet. I prefer watching South Indian films, as they focus on history and culture. Question: You own a helicopter, horses and luxury vehicles. How do you prefer to travel? Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh: I am a man of the ground. I prefer travelling by car. Question: What are the chances of Prateek becoming a minister in the UP cabinet? Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh: I do not see that possibility. Such decisions are taken by the organisation and the government. Question: Have you been given any responsibility for the upcoming three-tier elections? Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh: Last time, I was given responsibility in five districts, and we succeeded. Whether I will be given responsibility again is for the party to decide. Question: You reacted strongly when compared to Raja Bhaiya. Why? Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh: Such comparisons are driven by social media trends. They create unnecessary conflict among supporters. Raja Bhaiya has his own political standing and history. Comparing leaders in this way serves no purpose and harms society.

stories.title: Four die as car rams into truck on Delhi-Mumbai Expressway:Vehicle dragged for 8 km, family returning to Noida after Mahakal darshan
stories.summary: A speeding car rammed into the back of a truck on the Delhi-Mumbai Expressway in Dausa. Four people in the car died in the accident, while one young man was seriously injured. The car was severely stuck under the truck, causing it to be dragged along for some distance. The bodies were also trapped inside the car, and the police had to struggle to extricate them. The accident occurred near pillar number 193 of the expressway in the Paparda area on Tuesday morning at around 5:30 AM. All the deceased were young men from Noida. The car was completely wrecked, making it difficult to extract the bodies. PHOTOS from the accident... DSP Deepak Meena said that a car with a Haryana license plate was traveling from Lalsot (Dausa) towards Delhi. Near Aluda village, the car crashed into a truck ahead of it. Due to the high speed, the car got stuck under the back of the truck. The front of the car was completely destroyed, and the occupants were trapped inside. Police and the expressway's rescue team arrived at the scene. After considerable effort, the car was separated from the truck, and the bodies were removed. According to eyewitnesses, the truck driver did not immediately realize the accident had occurred. As a result, the car was dragged along with the truck. The car's occupants had no chance of survival. There were five people in the car. The injured young man has been admitted to the district hospital in Dausa. The police have placed the bodies in the mortuary. Their identities have not yet been established. The car traveled from one police station area to another Constable Mahesh of Paparda police station said that all the occupants of the car were returning to Noida after visiting the Mahakal temple in Ujjain. After crashing into the truck in the Rahuwas police station area, the speeding car got stuck. The car was then dragged into the Paparda police station area. Traffic on the expressway was affected for some time after the accident. Traffic was restored after the damaged vehicles were removed.

stories.title: UP plans Shiksha Mitra pay hike:Yogi government’s fifth budget likely to focus on women, pensioners ahead of 2027 polls
stories.summary: The Yogi Adityanath government’s fifth budget, to be presented in February, is expected to carry a strong welfare push aimed at women and socially vulnerable groups, as the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) sharpens its strategy for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. According to sources, the government is preparing to extend financial benefits to more than one crore women through proposed hikes in pensions and honorariums. The focus is on increasing old age pension, destitute women pension, widow pension, disability pension, as well as incentives for ASHA workers and honorarium for Shiksha Mitras. Political analysts view these moves as part of a broader effort to consolidate a vote bank that not only votes in large numbers but also plays a decisive role in shaping opinion at the village and neighbourhood level. Budget seen as key tool for electoral mobilisation With the 2027 elections still over a year away, the government has already begun aligning its budgetary priorities with political objectives. The past two days of political activity underline this shift. Union Home Minister Amit Shah recently hinted at the election timeline during the UP Day programme, while BJP national president Nitin Navin urged party workers in Mathura to begin preparations for 2027. Together, these developments signal that electoral groundwork has formally begun. For Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, retaining power for a third consecutive term remains the central challenge. Women voters played a decisive role in the BJP’s victories in the 2017 Assembly elections, the 2019 Lok Sabha polls, and the 2022 Assembly elections. The party has replicated this strategy in states such as Haryana, Maharashtra, Delhi and Bihar by announcing women-centric welfare schemes. Talks underway on pension and honorarium hikes Sources in the finance department say discussions have already taken place between Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, Finance Minister Suresh Khanna and Additional Chief Secretary (Finance) Deepak Kumar on increasing pension amounts for the elderly, destitute women and persons with disabilities. There is also a “principled agreement” to enhance incentives for ASHA workers and the honorarium paid to Shiksha Mitras. Budgetary calculations for these increases are currently underway. Honorarium hike likely for 1.47 lakh Shiksha Mitras After nearly nine years, the government is considering an increase in the honorarium of Shiksha Mitras. Around 1.47 lakh Shiksha Mitras and more than 28,000 instructors could benefit from the proposal. The key question under discussion is whether the honorarium should be increased by Rs 2,000 per month or more. The BJP had promised a legal solution to the Shiksha Mitra issue in its 2017 manifesto, but their adjustment as assistant teachers was later struck down by the Supreme Court. In 2017, the Yogi government had increased their honorarium from Rs 3,500 to Rs 10,000 per month. No revision has taken place since then, despite repeated demands from both ruling party and opposition legislators. Recently, Basic Education Minister Sandeep Singh also hinted at a possible increase. Pension hike for elderly, women and disabled persons At present, 67.50 lakh elderly people in Uttar Pradesh receive an old age pension of Rs 1,000 per month, paid quarterly. The finance department is considering increasing this amount to Rs 1,500 per month. If approved, this would be the third hike under the Yogi government, following increases in 2019 and 2022. Under the destitute women pension scheme, 38.58 lakh women currently receive Rs 1,000 per month. This amount is also proposed to be raised to Rs 1,500. Similarly, around 11.98 lakh persons with disabilities receive a monthly pension of Rs 1,000. The government is preparing to increase this to Rs 1,500 per month. ASHA workers and leprosy patients also to benefit Uttar Pradesh has nearly 1.70 lakh ASHA workers, considered the backbone of the rural healthcare system. They currently receive incentive payments ranging between Rs 2,500 and Rs 3,500 per month. A proposal to increase this incentive is under consideration. In addition, 13,395 leprosy patients who currently receive a monthly pension of Rs 3,000 may see this rise to between Rs 3,500 and Rs 4,000. Government targets one crore women beneficiaries Officials estimate that women form the majority of beneficiaries across most welfare schemes. Of the 67.50 lakh old age pension recipients, around 40 lakh are women. The destitute women pension scheme covers over 38 lakh women, while nearly five lakh women benefit from the disability pension scheme. Added to this are more than 1.60 lakh ASHA workers. Senior journalist and political analyst Virendra Nath Bhatt says pension hikes are often justified on inflation grounds, but political considerations cannot be ignored. “The government and the BJP have clearly begun election preparations. The upcoming budget is likely to contain populist announcements for every major social group,” he said. Former Additional Chief Secretary (Finance) Sanjeev Mittal noted that strong revenue collections from GST, VAT, excise, transport, and stamp and registration have given the government fiscal space. “When revenues are healthy, governments tend to increase spending on welfare schemes. Such spending also yields political dividends,” he said.
