stories.title: पुलिस ने स्टेशन और होटल ढाबों की चेकिंग की
stories.summary: संतकबीरनगर में गणतंत्र दिवस के मद्देनजर, सीओ सदर और कोतवाल ने रेलवे स्टेशन पर सघन चेकिंग की। पुलिस ने संदिग्ध व्यक्तियों और वस्तुओं की तलाश की और होटल, ढाबों, सरायों की जांच की। प्रबंधकों को नियमों का पालन करने और किसी संदिग्ध गतिविधि की सूचना देने की सख्त हिदायत दी गई।

stories.title: ग्राम रामजंगला की चकबंदी पर उठे सवाल, शासन स्तर से जांच के आदेश
stories.summary: संतकबीरनगर के रामजंगला गांव में चकबंदी प्रक्रिया को लेकर विवाद बढ़ रहा है। कुछ काश्तकारों ने इसका विरोध किया है और अधिसूचना निरस्त करने की मांग की है। विधायक गणेश चंद्र चौहान ने ग्रामीणों की आपत्तियों को शासन के समक्ष रखा है। जांच टीम ने 256 ग्रामीणों की राय ली, जिसमें 224 ने चकबंदी का समर्थन किया।

stories.title: मेरा युवा भारत शाहजहापुर ने भव्य रूप से मनाया गया राष्ट्रीय मतदाता दिवस 2026
stories.summary: मेरा युवा भारत शाहजहांपुर ने राष्ट्रीय मतदाता दिवस 2026 के अवसर पर MYBharat MYVote पदयात्रा का आयोजन किया। मुख्य अतिथि राज्यसभा सांसद मिथिलेश कुमार ने नव मतदाताओं को सम्मानित किया और मतदान की प्रक्रिया में भागीदारी के लिए प्रेरित किया।

stories.title: बंधक बनाकर चोरी की गई चार डायलिसिस मशीनें बरामद, दो गिरफ्तार
stories.summary: मऊ के आजमी अस्पताल में देर रात स्वास्थ्यकर्मी को बंधक बनाकर लगभग 28 लाख की चार डायलिसिस मशीन चोरी की गई थी। पुलिस ने एक चिकित्सक समेत दो आरोपियों को गिरफ्तार कर लिया है और गायब मशीनों को बरामद कर लिया है। पुलिस ने इस मामले में टीम बनाई थी और अन्य आरोपियों की पहचान कर रही है।

stories.title: एसडीएम की गाड़ी पर जानलेवा ठोकर मारने के पांच आरोपी दोषमुक्त
stories.summary: संतकबीरनगर में 20 साल पुराने मामले में, तत्कालीन उप जिलाधिकारी धनघटा के वाहन पर जान से मारने की नीयत से ठोकर मारने के आरोप में पूर्व छात्र संघ अध्यक्ष सहित पांच आरोपियों को कोर्ट ने साक्ष्य के अभाव में दोषमुक्त कर दिया। मामला बालू खनन से संबंधित था।

stories.title: कबीर मगहर महोत्सव को लेकर लगने लगा पंडाल
stories.summary: संतकबीरनगर में कबीर मगहर महोत्सव की तैयारियां शुरू हो गई हैं। यह महोत्सव 28 जनवरी से 2 फरवरी तक चलेगा। पण्डाल और जर्मन हैंगर लग रहे हैं। साफ-सफाई के लिए निर्देश दिए गए हैं। कार्यक्रम में नामी कलाकारों की प्रस्तुति होगी।

stories.title: इजराइल गए व्यक्ति की गिरफ्तारी के नाम पर ठगे 1.3 लाख रुपया
stories.summary: बस्ती में जालसाजों ने ट्रैवल एजेंट बनकर कोटेदार धर्मेंद्र से 1.3 लाख रुपये ठग लिए। जालसाजों ने धर्मेंद्र को व्हाट्सअप कॉल करके कहा कि उसका दोस्त सिकंदर खतरे में है। धर्मेंद्र ने विश्वास कर रुपये भेज दिए। बाद में जब सिकंदर से बात की, तो उसने बताया कि वह सुरक्षित है। पुलिस और साइबर सेल मामले की जांच कर रही है।

stories.title: नेपाल बॉर्डर से उत्तराखंड बॉर्डर तक सतर्कता
stories.summary: गणतंत्र दिवस के अवसर पर रेलवे स्टेशन, रोडवेज और अन्य परिवहन साधनों में संदिग्धों की जांच शुरू की गई। नेपाल बॉर्डर से उत्तराखंड तक चौकसी बढ़ाई गई है। जीआरपी ने ट्रेनों में चेकिंग अभियान चलाया, जबकि रोडवेज बसों में भी संदिग्ध व्यक्तियों की जांच की जा रही है।

stories.title: पत्नी को छत से नीचे फेंका खुद फंदा लगाकर जान दी, आए दिन करता था पिटाई
stories.summary: यूपी में बरेली के मीरगंज में कहासुनी पर युवक ने पत्नी को डंडों से पीटकर छत से नीचे फेंक दिया। पड़ोस के लोग महिला को गंभीर हालत में सीएचसी ले गए, जहां से उसे जिला अस्पताल रेफर कर दिया गया। इसी दौरान पति ने कमरे में कुंदे से लटककर खुदकुशी कर ली।

stories.title: मां गोमती उद्गम स्थल के विकास को मिली मंजूरी
stories.summary: उत्तर प्रदेश के मुख्यमंत्री योगी आदित्यनाथ ने विधायक बाबूराम पासवान की मांग पर मां गोमती उद्गम स्थल के विकास के लिए बजट मंजूर किया है। इसमें मल्टीपरपज हाल, सुलभ प्रसाधन, पेयजल व्यवस्था, और अन्य सुविधाओं का निर्माण किया जाएगा। इससे श्रद्धालुओं और पर्यटकों को बेहतर सुविधाएं मिलेंगी और क्षेत्र का धार्मिक एवं पर्यटन विकास होगा।

stories.title: चलो मतदान करे हम का संदेश दिया
stories.summary: गांधी प्रेक्षागृह में राष्ट्रीय मतदाता दिवस के अवसर पर छात्रों ने सांस्कृतिक कार्यक्रम प्रस्तुत किए। 'चलो मतदान करें' का नारा दिया गया और मतदाताओं को मतदान का महत्व समझाया गया। नाटक के माध्यम से छात्राओं ने वोट की कीमत के बारे में जागरूकता फैलाई। इस कार्यक्रम में कई अधिकारी भी उपस्थित थे।

stories.title: सोने-चांदी की मंहगाई में बंद हो गया उधार का कारोबार
stories.summary: संतकबीरनगर में सोने-चांदी की बढ़ती मंहगाई ने सराफा व्यवसाय में बदलाव ला दिया है। उधारी का कारोबार बंद हो गया है, जिससे बिक्री 40-50% तक प्रभावित हुई है। व्यवसायी अब नगद में ही लेनदेन कर रहे हैं और पुराने दाम पर कोई गारंटी नहीं है। ग्राहकों की फंसी हुई पूंजी भी कारोबार को प्रभावित कर रही है।

stories.title: शराबी ने बाइक में लगाई आग, बुझाने में परिवार के चार लोग झुलसे
stories.summary: शराब के नशे में धुत युवक ने घर पहुंचकर अपनी बाइक में आग लगा दी। आग बुझाने के प्रयास में चार परिवार के लोग झुलस गए। सभी को जिला अस्पताल में भर्ती कराया गया, जहां दो लोगों की हालत गंभीर बताई जा रही है। पुलिस ने आरोपी की तलाश शुरू कर दी है।

stories.title: शेयर खरीद के नाम पर ठग लिए 2.19 लाख रुपये
stories.summary: बस्ती में ट्रेडिंग में मुनाफे का झांसा देकर 2.19 लाख रुपये का साइबर फ्राड हुआ है। आरोप है कि दिनेश नाम के व्यक्ति को जालसाज ने निवेश करने के लिए फंसाया और विभिन्न तारीखों में पैसे ट्रांसफर कराए। जब दिनेश ने अपने निवेश की जानकारी ली, तब उसे धोखाधड़ी का पता चला। पुलिस ने मामला दर्ज कर जांच शुरू कर दी है।

stories.title: बच्चों पर कोल्ड अलर्जी का हमला, लाडले को ठंड से बचाएं
stories.summary: कड़ाके की ठंड खत्म होने के बाद मौसम में तेजी से बदलाव ने छोटे बच्चों को कोल्ड अलर्जी का शिकार बना दिया है। 5 महीने से 2 साल के कई बच्चे सर्दी, जुकाम और बुखार से प्रभावित हैं। चिकित्सकों ने अभिभावकों को सलाह दी है कि बच्चों की सेहत पर विशेष ध्यान दें और समस्या होने पर चिकित्सक से संपर्क करें।

stories.title: नेपाल से विवाह कर भारत में आई हजारों बहुएं मतदान से रहेंगी वंचित!
stories.summary: महराजगंज में नेपाल से विवाह कर आई बहुएं अब भारत में मतदान नहीं कर सकेंगी। चुनाव आयोग द्वारा भेजे गए नो मैपिंग नोटिस के चलते इन महिलाओं के पास भारत में रहने का कोई प्रमाण नहीं है। जनसुनवाई केंद्रों पर दस्तावेज प्रस्तुत करने में समस्याएं आ रही हैं, जिससे उनकी चुनावी भागीदारी प्रभावित हो रही है।

stories.title: गोमती के प्राकृतिक जलस्रोत के संरक्षण का संकल्प, अनुष्ठान
stories.summary: धोबिया गांव के तपोवन सिद्ध आश्रम में एक क्षतिग्रस्त प्राकृतिक जलस्रोत के संरक्षण और सौंदर्यीकरण की शुरुआत हुई। सुशील सीतापुरी ने मां भगवती की उपस्थिति में पूजा करके निर्माण कार्य का शुभारंभ किया। यह जलस्रोत गोमती नदी को साल भर जलापूर्ति करता है, इसलिए इसका संरक्षण आवश्यक है।

stories.title: Three passengers killed as two omni-buses collide at Kottampatti near Madurai
stories.summary: 20 injured persons admitted to Government Rajaji hospital

stories.title: शिक्षा चौपाल के जरिए दिया बालिका शिक्षा पर जोर
stories.summary: बाकेगंज ब्लॉक के पसियापुर ग्रंट में शिक्षा चौपाल का आयोजन हुआ। मां सरस्वती के पूजन के साथ कार्यक्रम की शुरुआत हुई। अभिभावकों की बड़ी संख्या ने भाग लिया। निपुण लक्ष्य, कायाकल्प योजना, और डिजिटल संसाधनों पर चर्चा की गई। विद्यालयों ने टीएलएम प्रस्तुत किए और उत्कृष्ट बच्चों एवं शिक्षकों को सम्मानित किया गया।

stories.title: KGMU में लिवर प्रेशर माप की शुरुआत, गंभीर मरीजों के इलाज में आएगा बड़ा बदलाव
stories.summary: KGMU Introduces Liver Pressure Measurement Technique: किंग जॉर्ज मेडिकल यूनिवर्सिटी (KGMU ) ने लिवर रोगों के इलाज के क्षेत्र में एक महत्वपूर्ण उपलब्धि हासिल की है। अब यहां लिवर प्रेशर मापने की आधुनिक और वैज्ञानिक प्रक्रिया की शुरुआत कर दी गई है, जिससे गंभीर लिवर रोगियों के उपचार में क्रांतिकारी बदलाव आने की उम्मीद है। इस नई तकनीक के जरिए अब दवाओं की डोज मरीज के लिवर प्रेशर के आधार पर तय की जा सकेगी, जिससे इलाज अधिक सटीक, प्रभावी और सुरक्षित होगा।

stories.title: महंगाई में भी पीतल का झंडा हो रहा 'ऊंचा'
stories.summary: मुरादाबाद में पीतल से बने तिरंगे और अशोक की लाट की मांग बरकरार है, जबकि महंगाई की वजह से पीतल के कच्चे माल की लागत बढ़ रही है। सेना की छावनियों से सबसे ज्यादा ऑर्डर मिल रहे हैं, लेकिन महंगे होते उत्पादों के कारण निर्यात में कमी आई है। प्लास्टिक के सस्ते विकल्प के बावजूद, पीतल के उत्पादों की खास पहचान है।

stories.title: राष्ट्रवाद के रंग में रंगा शहर
stories.summary: गणतंत्र दिवस पर मेरठ की सड़कों पर देशभक्ति का सैलाब उमड़ पड़ा। भाजपा नेता कमल दत्त शर्मा की अगुवाई में आयोजित 'तिरंगा बाइक रैली' ने शहर को तिरंगे के रंग में सराबोर कर दिया। हजारों युवा तिरंगा लेकर बाइक पर निकले और 'भारत माता की जय' के नारों से गूंज उठी।

stories.title: ग्रामीण सफाई कर्मचारी संघ के ब्लॉक चुनाव की तिथि घोषित
stories.summary: उप्र पंचायती राज ग्रामीण सफाई कर्मचारी संघ ने डीपीआरओ श्रेया मिश्रा को पत्रक देकर चुनाव/अधिवेशन की तिथियों की घोषणा की है। यह चुनाव 30 जनवरी से 9 फरवरी तक विभिन्न ब्लॉकों में आयोजित होंगे। चुनाव संबंधित ब्लॉक सभागार में सुबह 10 बजे से शुरू होंगे, जिसमें सफाई कर्मचारी मतदान में भाग लेंगे।

stories.title: खिली धूप में बर्फीली हवा चली, दो दिन बारिश के आसार
stories.summary: पिछले हफ्ते पहाड़ों पर बर्फबारी और मुरादाबाद में बारिश के कारण मौसम में बदलाव आया। रविवार को धूप निकली, लेकिन ठंड बनी रही। मौसम विभाग ने मंगलवार और बुधवार को फिर से बारिश की संभावना जताई है। अधिकतम तापमान 18 डिग्री सेल्सियस रह सकता है।

stories.title: महिला की ट्रेन की चपेट में आने से मौत
stories.summary: एक महिला अपनी शौच के लिए जाते समय ट्रेन की चपेट में आ गई, जिससे उसकी मौके पर ही मौत हो गई। घटना बिनावर थाना क्षेत्र के घटपुरी रेलवे स्टेशन के पास हुई। मृतका के परिवार में शोक की लहर है। पुलिस ने शव को कब्जे में लेकर पोस्टमार्टम के लिए भेज दिया और मामले की जांच शुरू कर दी है।

stories.title: बाल विवाह मुक्त समाज के लिए दिलाई गई शपथ
stories.summary: महराजगंज में 66वीं वाहिनी सशस्त्र सीमा बल और महिला एवं बाल कल्याण विभाग ने बाल विवाह मुक्त समाज के लिए जागरूकता अभियान चलाया। शिव मंदिर परिसर में आयोजित इस कार्यक्रम में ग्रामीणों को बाल विवाह, बाल श्रम और महिला उत्पीड़न के खिलाफ जागरूक किया गया। बच्चों की शिक्षा और सुरक्षा के लिए शपथ दिलाई गई।

stories.title: साहित्योत्सव में आज जुटेंगे नामचीन शायर व कवि
stories.summary: उदीषा साहित्य महोत्सव में कवि सम्मेलन होगा जिसमें हरिओम पंवार, डा. विष्णु सक्सेना और अन्य साहित्यकार शामिल होंगे। दोपहर में मनोज जोशी और अनुषा रिजवी का संवाद कार्यक्रम होगा। इसके अलावा, संदीप सिंह और आचार्य प्रमोद कृष्णम टेम्पल इकोनॉमिक्स पर विचार साझा करेंगे। शाम को कव्वाली और अन्य सांस्कृतिक कार्यक्रम भी होंगे।

stories.title: मतदाता दिवस पर ज्यादा मतदान करने की ली शपथ
stories.summary: मतदाता दिवस पर पंचायत भवन में कार्यक्रम आयोजित किया गया। सभी को मतदान की शपथ दिलाई गई और मतदान के प्रति जागरूक किया गया। जिलाधिकारी अनुज सिंह और उप जिला निर्वाचन अधिकारी संगीता गौतम ने लोकतंत्र की मजबूती के लिए कर्तव्यों का पालन करने का संदेश दिया। बच्चों ने भी मतदाता जागरूकता कार्यक्रमों का आयोजन किया।

stories.title: कंटेनर और ट्रैक्टर में भिड़ंत, चालक की मौत
stories.summary: बदायूं-फर्रूखाबाद हाईवे पर कंटेनर और ट्रैक्टर ट्राला के बीच भीषण टक्कर हो गई। हादसे में कंटेनर चालक गोवर्धन की मौत हो गई, जबकि ट्रैक्टर चालक का कोई पता नहीं चला। दुर्घटना के कारण हाईवे पर दो घंटे तक यातायात प्रभावित रहा। पुलिस ने क्रेन की मदद से कंटेनर को हटाया और यातायात को सुचारू किया।

stories.title: फसल लगी खेतों में चकरोड भराई काम में लगा भर दी हाजिरी!
stories.summary: महराजगंज के गनेशपुर में मनरेगा योजना के तहत बिना काम कराए फर्जी हाजिरी लगाने का आरोप है। शिकायतकर्ता ने बताया कि पहले से किए गए कार्य का भुगतान फिर से दिखाया जा रहा है। बीडीओ ने मामले की जांच का आश्वासन दिया है।

stories.title: पीले वस्त्रों में सजी श्रद्धा, हल्लू सराय में निकली भव्य कलश यात्रा
stories.summary: हल्लू सराय के प्राचीन चामुंडा मंदिर पर श्री लक्ष्मीनारायण महायज्ञ और श्रीमद्भागवत कथा का आयोजन किया गया। पहले दिन यज्ञ संपन्न हुआ, जिसमें श्रद्धालुओं ने आहुतियां दीं। महिलाओं ने कलश यात्रा निकाली, जिसमें भक्तिभाव के साथ भाग लिया। कथा के दौरान बड़ी संख्या में श्रद्धालुओं के आने की उम्मीद है।

stories.title: मणिकर्णिका घाट जा रहे सपाजनों को रोका, एमएलसी समेत 15 हिरासत में
stories.summary: वाराणसी में मणिकर्णिका घाट जाने वाले सपाजनों को पुलिस ने लहुराबीर चौराहे पर रोका। एमएलसी आशुतोष सिन्हा समेत 15 नेताओं को हिरासत में लिया गया। सपा ने घाट पर अहिल्या बाई की प्रतिमा को ध्वस्त करने के विरोध में प्रदर्शन का निर्णय लिया था, जिसके चलते पुलिस ने एहतियात के तौर पर सुरक्षा व्यवस्था की थी।

stories.title: मतदाता दिवस पर युवाओं ने भरी हुंकार, निकली जागरूकता रैली
stories.summary: शहर के एमजीएम कॉलेज में रविवार को राष्ट्रीय मतदाता दिवस पर मतदाता जागरूकता कार्यक्रम आयोजित किया गया। मुख्य अतिथि एसडीएम रामानुज ने मतदान की शपथ दिलाई और छात्रों को मतदान के महत्व के बारे में बताया। कार्यक्रम के बाद एक मतदाता जागरूकता रैली निकाली गई जिसमें छात्रों और शिक्षकों ने भाग लिया।

stories.title: शाम होते ही तिरंगा रंग में दिखेंगी शहर की सड़कें
stories.summary: गणतंत्र दिवस की तैयारी के तहत नगर पालिका प्रशासन ने शहर के सभी बिजली पोल पर तिरंगा रंग की लाइट लगाने का काम तेज कर दिया है। 26 जनवरी से पहले सभी पोल को तिरंगा लाइट से सजाया जाएगा। स्ट्रीट लाइट को जलाने और बुझाने के लिए कर्मचारियों की ड्यूटी लगाई गई है।

stories.title: 31 जनवरी तक दावे और आपत्तियां करा सकते हैं दर्ज
stories.summary: गाजीपुर में उप जिला निर्वाचन अधिकारी दिनेश कुमार ने दावे और आपत्तियों के लिए विशेष अभियान की तिथि 31 जनवरी घोषित की है। सभी बूथों पर बूथ लेवल अधिकारी सुबह 10:30 बजे से शाम 4:30 बजे तक उपस्थित रहेंगे। मतदाता फार्म-6, फार्म-7 और फार्म-8 के माध्यम से आवेदन कर सकते हैं।

stories.title: युवती का अपहरण कर ले जाने में काशीपुर के युवक पर केस
stories.summary: शहर कोतवाली क्षेत्र के मछली बाजार निवासी एक महिला की बेटी घर से गायब हो गई। महिला जब नहाने गई थी, तब उसकी बेटी घर पर थी। बाद में पता चला कि उसे जैद हुसैन उर्फ बाबू ने ले गया। महिला ने पुलिस में शिकायत दर्ज कराई, जिसके बाद आरोपी के खिलाफ केस दर्ज किया गया।

stories.title: Outrage after US agents kill ICU nurse Alex Pretti in Minnesota
stories.summary: Authorities say Alex Pretti posed a violent threat when shot by US ICE agents, but multiple videos suggest otherwise.

stories.title: बोरे में बंद कर पुल पर फेंकी युवती की लाश, रात के अंधेरे में ठिकाने लगाने निकले थे हत्यारे
stories.summary: यूपी के आगरा में नेशनल हाईवे स्थित एत्मादुद्दौला के जवाहरपुल पर शनिवार देर रात पुलिस को एक प्लास्टिक का बोरा मिला। उसे खोला गया तो अंदर काली प्लास्टिक में लिपटी हुई एक युवती की लाश थी। शरीर ताजा खून से सना हुआ था।

stories.title: लोगों को निष्पक्ष मतदान की दिलाई गई शपथ
stories.summary: मऊ में राष्ट्रीय मतदाता दिवस के अवसर पर जागरुकता कार्यक्रम आयोजित किए गए। अपर जिलाधिकारी सत्यप्रिय सिंह की अध्यक्षता में नगर पालिका परिषद के कम्युनिटी हाल में मतदाताओं को शत प्रतिशत मतदान करने की शपथ दिलाई गई। छात्रों ने नुक्कड़ नाटक के माध्यम से मतदान के प्रति जागरूकता फैलाई।

stories.title: कुछ लोग राजनीति में टाइम पास के लिए आते हैं; मथुरा में नितिन नवीन ने राहुल गांधी का नाम लिए बिना कसा तंज
stories.summary: भारतीय जनता पार्टी के राष्ट्रीय अध्यक्ष नितिन नवीन और मुख्यमंत्री योगी आदित्यनाथ रविवार को मथुरा पहुंचे। यहां दोनों ने वृंदावन स्थित बांके बिहारी मंदिर में पूजा अर्चना की। यहां नितिन नवीन ने राहुल गांधी का नाम लिये बगैर कहा है कि कुछ लोग राजनीति में टाइम पास के लिए आते हैं।

stories.title: विवाहिता को मारपीट कर घर से निकाला,केस दर्ज
stories.summary: अमरोहा की आशा का विवाह 2020 में योगेश कुमार से हुआ था। ससुराल वालों ने दस लाख रुपये की दहेज मांगने पर उसे परेशान किया। पति और अन्य ससुरालियों ने मारपीट की और जान से मारने की धमकी दी। पीड़िता ने सिविल लाइंस कोतवाली में रिपोर्ट दर्ज कराई है।

stories.title: UGC 2026 के नए नियमों पर भाजपा एमएलसी की आपत्ति, शिक्षा व्यवस्था में जातीय तनाव की चेतावनी
stories.summary: UGC Rules: विश्वविद्यालय अनुदान आयोग (UGC) द्वारा वर्ष 2026 के लिए प्रस्तावित नए नियमों को लेकर सियासत और शिक्षा जगत में बहस तेज हो गई है। भाजपा के विधान परिषद सदस्य (MLC) देवेन्द्र प्रताप सिंह ने यूजीसी को एक विस्तृत चिट्ठी लिखकर इन नियमों पर गंभीर आपत्ति जताई है। उन्होंने आशंका व्यक्त की है कि यदि इन नियमों को वर्तमान स्वरूप में लागू किया गया, तो इससे देश की पूरी शिक्षा व्यवस्था छिन्न-भिन्न हो सकती है और समाज में जातीय संघर्ष को बढ़ावा मिल सकता है।

stories.title: Arsenal vs Manchester United 2-3: Premier League – as it happened
stories.summary: All the updates as United shock Arsenal with stunning second-half goals from Patrick Dorgu and ⁠Matheus Cunha.

stories.title: पुराल से भरी ट्राली में लगी आग
stories.summary: रामपुर के टांडा में मुरादाबाद मार्ग पर पुराल से भरी ट्रैक्टर ट्राली में आग लग गई। चालक की सूझबूझ से ट्राली को आबादी से बाहर निकाला गया। आग पर दो घंटे बाद काबू पाया गया। पुलिस ने ट्रैफिक संचालन को रोक दिया था। आग लगने का कारण अभी स्पष्ट नहीं है।

stories.title: कैफे से युवती के कूदने के मामले में प्रेमी की तहरीर पर मुकदमा
stories.summary: बरेली मोड़ पर एक कैफे से युवक-युवती ने कूदने का मामला सामने आया है। युवक ने तहरीर दी है, जिसके आधार पर पुलिस ने तीन नामजद और चार-पांच अज्ञात लोगों के खिलाफ मुकदमा दर्ज किया है। दोनों घायलों का इलाज एक निजी अस्पताल में चल रहा है। घटना के पीछे डराने-धमकाने की वजह बताई गई है।

stories.title: कल से 31 जनवरी तक होंगी प्रयोगात्मक परीक्षाएं
stories.summary: स्व़ डम्मर लाल राजपूत इंटर कालेज में इंटरमीडिट की प्रयोगात्मक परीक्षाएँ 27 से 31 जनवरी तक आयोजित की जाएंगी। पहले दिन जीव विज्ञान, दूसरे दिन भौतिक विज्ञान, खेल, योग, शारीरिक शिक्षा, और अंतिम दिन ग्रह विज्ञान की परीक्षाएँ होंगी। प्रधानाचार्य ने यह जानकारी दी है।

stories.title: सर्राफा बाजार का बदला मिजाज, नकद में ही लेनदेन
stories.summary: महंगाई के कारण महराजगंज में शादी-विवाह वाले परिवारों की चिंता बढ़ गई है। सोने-चांदी की कीमतों में वृद्धि से ग्राहकों की संख्या कम हो गई है। छोटे स्वर्णकार अब नकद में जेवरात बेच रहे हैं और उधारी का लेनदेन 40-50 प्रतिशत घट गया है। चांदी का दाम प्रति किलो 3 लाख पार पहुंच गया है।

stories.title: खजुरिया के युवक की केरल में मौत
stories.summary: खजुरिया थाना क्षेत्र के ग्राम रम्पुरा निवासी शहादत हुसैन ने शिकायत की है कि उनके गांव के मोहम्मद रफीक का पुत्र शहजान, जो केरल में सुपरवाइजर था, 19 जनवरी की रात कुछ लोगों द्वारा कमरे से बुलाकर ले जाया गया और रेलवे क्रॉसिंग के पास हत्या कर दी गई। पुलिस ने पोस्टमार्टम के बाद शव परिजनों को सौंप दिया।

stories.title: राजकीय पॉलिटेक्निक में दीक्षांत समारोह आयोजित

System responsible for the death of Noida's engineer; 7 held accountable On the night of January 16 in Noida, software engineer Yuvraj died due to drowning in water. A Special Investigation Team (SIT) was formed by the administration regarding the incident. SIT asked more than 22 questions from three departments, including the Authority. 3. 13-year-old girl raped for 15 days in Gorakhpur: Lover abandons woman at hotel, sells her to spa centre; 3 arrested A 13-year-old girl was kidnapped by her lover and held hostage in a hotel in Gorakhpur. She was raped for three days. The girl alleged that when her condition deteriorated, she was given medicine. After that, she was sold to a spa center. 4. EC releases list of 12.5 crore voters with discrepancies Acting on directions of the Supreme Court, the Election Commission on Saturday uploaded on its website the list of voters flagged under the ‘Logical Discrepancy’ category during the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise. 5. Avimukteshwaranand says, 'I won't step back': Some people tried to enter the camp; raises slogan ‘Yogi Zindabad’ The dispute between Avimukteshwaranand and the fair administration in Prayagraj has been ongoing for 7 days. On Saturday night, 10 to 15 youths from an organization called Kattar Sanatani Sena arrived chanting slogans with saffron flags. 6. MP Virendra Singh clashes with Police, sits on protest: Asks, what is the government hiding? An 11-member SP delegation is adamant about going to Manikarnika Ghat in Varanasi. However, before the delegation could depart, the police administration placed SP officials and party leaders under house arrest. 7. Another Hindu youth was burnt alive in Bangladesh while sleeping in a shop; 10 Hindus were killed in the last 40 days Another incident of violence against minorities has been reported from Bangladesh, where a 23-year-old Hindu youth was burnt to death in Narsindi district, police said on Saturday. 8. BJP National President Nitin Navin visits Mathura: Flowers showered from a bulldozer during welcome BJP National President Nitin Navin has arrived in Mathura. BJP workers welcomed him enthusiastically with drums and percussion. Flowers were showered from a bulldozer. After this, Nitin Navin waved a mace from the stage. 9. Moradabad Class 12 student alleges friends forced to wear burqa: Girl says, ‘she was misled, brother lodges FIR’ Perhaps my destiny was good. My eyes opened early. Otherwise, I, too, might have been found in 35 pieces. My Muslim friends were constantly instigating me to adopt Islam. 10. Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities emerge as new job hubs India is witnessing a major shift in its job market, with recruitment growth accelerating rapidly in Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities. Cities such as Indore, Jaipur, Ahmedabad, Kochi, and Chandigarh are leading the wave.

stories.title: बस्ती के आठ विद्यालयों को मिला स्वच्छता पुरस्कार
stories.summary: बस्ती के आठ विद्यालयों को भारत सरकार द्वारा 'स्वच्छ विद्यालय' पुरस्कार दिया गया। यह पुरस्कार उत्तर प्रदेश स्थापना दिवस पर कैबिनेट मंत्री आशीष पटेल और अन्य अधिकारियों ने प्रदान किया। पुरस्कार पाने वाले विद्यालयों में पीएमश्री स्कूल मूड़घाट, विद्यालय पसड़ा कुदरहा, प्राथमिक विद्यालय कुंवरपुर, और अन्य शामिल हैं।

stories.title: डीजीपी के निर्देश पर दहेज उत्पीड़न का मुकदमा

stories.title: शादी का भरोसा देकर शारीरिक शोषण का आरोप, केस

stories.title: पालीटेक्निक दीक्षांत समारोह में सम्मानित हुए मेधावी

stories.title: एनसीसी कैडेट्स, स्काउट गाइड ने ली शपथ

stories.title: दो ग्राम प्रधान राष्ट्रीय स्तर होंगे सम्मानित

stories.title: Mamta Kulkarni questions Akhilesh on cow slaughter issue:Speaks on Avimukteshwaranand controversy, claims 9 out of 10 Mahamandaleshwars and Shankaracharyas are fake
stories.summary: Former actress and Mahamandaleshwar of Kinnar Akhara, Mamta Kulkarni (Yamai Mamta Nand Giri), has jumped into the Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand controversy. She asked two questions. First - who appointed him as Shankaracharya? Second - what was the need to come out with a chariot (palanquin) amidst a crowd of millions? Mamta Kulkarni alleged that Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand was responsible for his disciples being beaten. If he had to bathe, he could have gotten off the palanquin and walked to bathe. Being a guru means responsible conduct, not such stubbornness, the price of which disciples have to pay. Raising questions about SP chief Akhilesh Yadav, Mamta Kulkarni asked - can he promise to stop cow slaughter? Will Akhilesh Yadav give any concrete assurance on stopping the cow slaughter that is being talked about? Mamta cited the dialogue between Rishi Kunal and Shvetaketu in the Rigveda and said that religion should be kept away from politics. Praised PM Modi and Priyanka Actually, in a conversation with IANS news agency, Mamta Kulkarni praised PM Modi. She said- Currently, no alternative to PM Narendra Modi is visible and Modi will continue to be there in the future. Look at the situation, if PM Modi is there, then nothing wrong is happening anywhere. If anyone feels something is wrong, tell me. We are doing everything peacefully. No one has any problem. They said - these people, meaning Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand Ji, are leaning towards the Samajwadi Party because they have only one issue. Cows should not be slaughtered. So, will these questions be resolved by going with Akhilesh Yadav? A lot of arrogance in Avimukteshwaranand Mamta Kulkarni said - Be it a king or a pauper, everyone has to obey the law and no one should be arrogant. One does not become a Shankaracharya merely by memorizing the four Vedas. He (Avimukteshwaranand) has a lot of arrogance and zero self-knowledge. So-called Shankaracharyas are fake Mamta Kulkarni also launched a major attack on the Mahamandaleshwars. She said - nine out of ten Mahamandaleshwars and so-called Shankaracharyas are fake and have zero knowledge. She claimed that her Guru was from the Nath sect and was an ascetic saint. Mamata Banerjee won by the power of Mahakali Mamata described Congress leader Priyanka Gandhi as more capable than Rahul Gandhi. Regarding West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee, Mamata said- Last year, BJP put all its might into Bengal, but Mamata Banerjee won with the power of Mahakali. Mamata Kulkarni also clarified that she will not return to Bollywood in this lifetime and she also has to be freed from the post of Mahamandaleshwar. Finally, she advised Mamata Banerjee not to take an extreme stance on any issue.

stories.title: Workers clash at Chandrashekhar rally in Agra:MP urges patience; stating people have suffered for centuries and must endure a little longer
stories.summary: In Agra, workers of the Azad Samaj Party clashed during MP Chandrashekhar Azad's rally, leading to chaos in front of the stage. Pushing and shoving, along with kicks and punches, broke out as supporters tried to get closer to Chandrashekhar. The situation became so tense that police had to step in to control the crowd. Chandrashekhar appealed for calm, urging supporters to endure a little more. He said those who suffer today will not face hardship for hundreds of years. He also criticised the administration for not allowing the rally at Ram Leela Maidan and promised that, if his party forms the UP government, false cases against workers will be withdrawn, and the poor will get free education and healthcare. Chandrashekhar arrived in Agra on Sunday and held the rally at GIC ground. Thousands of supporters from Agra and nearby districts attended to listen to him ahead of the assembly elections. There were arguments and scuffles between police and SP members at several places. Police have made strict security arrangements to stop them. A heavy police force has been deployed at Varanasi Circuit House and SP MP Virendra Singh's residence. During this time, MP Virendra Singh had a heated argument with the police. Later, MP Virendra Singh sat on a protest on the road. ADM City has also reached the spot. Meanwhile, OBC Morcha State Secretary Pandhari Yadav from Phulpur reached Circuit House, but the police stopped him from proceeding further. The delegation says they want to go to Manikarnika Ghat to get complete information about the incident of vandalism of Rajmata Ahilyabai's statue.

stories.title: Officers' salaries in Lucknow to be released based on performance:Municipal Commissioner Gaurav Kumar gives directions to increase tax collection in one week
stories.summary: Municipal Commissioner Gaurav Kumar has warned officials for negligence in house tax collection in Lucknow. Action is being prepared against 14 tax superintendents and tax inspectors, along with others who are performing poorly in tax collection. Zonal officers have also been asked to improve their performance within a week. If performance does not improve, their salary will be withheld, and a letter will be sent to the administration for adverse entry. Action against those with less than 25 percent recovery In a meeting with officials to increase tax collection, the Municipal Commissioner said that action will be taken against those who show negligence. The Municipal Corporation had given different level targets to officials for increasing taxes. This included a target of 25 percent more tax collection compared to last year. Officials have one week's time Meanwhile, the salaries of 7 zonal officers out of 8 zones have been withheld in the last meeting for not meeting the target. Now, if tax collection does not increase in these zones within a week, salaries will not be released. Orders have also been given to take departmental action against Tax Superintendent Surendra Singh and others posted in Zone Eight. They have collected significantly less tax compared to last year.

stories.title: 13-year-old girl raped for 15 days in Gorakhpur:Lover abandons woman at hotel, sells her to spa centre; 3 arrested
stories.summary: A 13-year-old girl was kidnapped by her lover and held hostage in a hotel in Gorakhpur. She was raped for three days. The girl alleged that when her condition deteriorated, she was given medicine. After that, she was sold to a spa center. The police, who had been searching for the girl for 15 days after registering a missing person report, recovered her from a hotel in Nausadh on January 20. The girl was handed over to her family without a medical examination. Then the girl's mother reached the SP City. When the matter reached SP City, the police became active. On Saturday, police arrested the hotel owner and the manager of Green Diamond and Beauty Spa Center. On Saturday night, the minor lover was also taken into custody by the police. He is also being interrogated. Police are searching for this entire network. The girl has alleged rape, but police say that things will only become clear after the medical examination. If confirmed in the investigation, rape charges will be added. Lover fled leaving her at hotel after staying for 3 days Police investigation has revealed that the girl was in contact with a teenager from the Shahpur area for 6 months. She used to operate an Instagram ID on her mother's mobile. Before the kidnapping, her ID was locked. According to the facts that have emerged so far, the lover took the girl to a hotel in the GIDA area on January 5. He stayed there for three days. During this time, he raped the girl. Suddenly, he disappeared from there. Hotel owner-manager raped lone girl After her boyfriend ran away, the girl was left alone in the hotel. Taking advantage of this, the hotel owner and manager raped her. In her statement, the girl said that she was also given medicine when she fell ill. Hotel owner-manager sold girl to spa center After this, the hotel owner-manager sold her to the spa center operator in Badhalganj. It is alleged that the spa manager also raped the girl. Her health deteriorated here as well. After this, she was brought to a hotel in Nausadh. She was kept hidden here. Police searching for the girl got a tip about her location on January 20. Reaching the hotel, the police recovered the girl. Mother reached SP City with the girl The police handed over the girl to her family on January 20. When the girl narrated her entire ordeal at home, the mother approached the SP City with a complaint. After this, the hotel owner, manager, and spa center manager were arrested by the police. When the girl was recovered, her medical examination was not conducted. A major prostitution case could open up again. The business of spa centers and substandard hotels is flourishing in the city. Such hotels are abundant in the outer areas of the city and on highways. Last year, too, a big racket was exposed in a similar case. Once again, the matter of selling a minor girl has come to light. This case could also be linked to prostitution. SP City Abhinav Tyagi said- The girl has been rescued. Police have arrested three accused. Further legal action is being taken.

stories.title: BJP President warns citizens to brace for 2027:Says earlier UP governments were run by guns; but now some people cannot accept development
stories.summary: Bharatiya Janata Party national president Nitin Navin has sounded the election bugle for Uttar Pradesh in 2027. On Sunday, he told party workers: “Brace yourselves, 2027 is coming. There are forces in the country that believe in dividing and breaking the nation. These forces come alive especially during elections. We have to fight them too.” He further said: “There are people roaming around who tore the Constitution apart, who ignored the development of Uttar Pradesh and only promoted anarchic elements. We have not forgotten that at one time, the government of Uttar Pradesh was run at gunpoint, but today the government of UP runs on the people’s votes.”

stories.title: 15-year-old dies by suicide in Ratlam after father's scolding:Boy found hanging from rope inside auto rickshaw parked outside home
stories.summary: A 15-year-old minor boy committed suicide in the Noori Nagar area of Ratlam after being upset by his father's scolding. The incident occurred on Saturday night in the Salakhedi outpost area. The minor hanged himself with a rope in his father's auto rickshaw that was parked in front of the house. The deceased was identified as Mehmood (15), son of Ahmad Shah. His body was found in suspicious circumstances near the auto rickshaw parked in an empty plot outside the house around 7:30 PM on Saturday night. When neighbours saw him in an unconscious state, there was panic. They immediately informed his mother, who was present in the house. The mother came outside and started crying seeing her son's condition. With the help of neighbours, he was taken to the district hospital around 8 PM, where doctors declared him dead. Upon receiving information, the father also reached the hospital. After reaching home, he went and sat in the auto According to ASI Bablu Daga, the deceased's father has three auto rickshaws. During questioning, it emerged that on Saturday evening, around 7 PM, the father was going to drop off passengers. During this time, he saw his son with some boys and stopped the auto to scold him. He had said, "Don't hang around with wayward boys." After this, the father left from there. It is being reported that after reaching home, the teenager sat in another parked auto. He kept crying for a long time and then hanged himself with a rope lying there. Commotion at hospital, dispute over PM After the incident, a chaotic situation developed at the district hospital at night. Doctors suggested sending the body to the medical college for a postmortem, but the family members were not ready for this. ASI Bablu Daga and other police personnel who reached the spot convinced the family members. After a long time, around 10 PM, the family members agreed for the postmortem, after which the body was kept in the medical college mortuary. The postmortem will be conducted on Sunday morning. Marks on neck, rope was tied in auto Initially, family members avoided saying anything about the incident. Later, the father admitted that there were marks on his son's neck, and a rope was found near the auto. Police investigation revealed that the rope was tied inside the auto rickshaw, while the body was found pressed against the outside. Police have registered a case and started investigating the matter.

stories.title: Yamunanagar woman attempts suicide over forced conversion:She says, 'Husband changed my name on Aadhar card', was in contact with 4 Hindu girls'; victim attempted suicide 3 days ago
stories.summary: Rekha, a woman from Yamunanagar, Haryana, who drank mercury by breaking a thermometer, has made several shocking revelations. After marriage, her husband, Furkan, changed her name on the Aadhar card to Rubina, the same as his first wife's name. Before the nikah, he trapped her in a love affair for 6 months using the name Ajay. In a conversation with the Dainik Bhaskar app, the woman claimed that Furkan was in contact with 4 other Hindu girls. He would talk to them privately on the phone and ask them to marry him. Furkan also took her to a program where he was honored for marrying a Hindu woman. Meanwhile, the woman says she now wants to go to Haridwar and return to Hinduism. The previous day, the woman attempted suicide by drinking mercury. She had alleged that Furkan, who runs a tile factory, forcibly converted her religion by taking her to Deoband in Saharanpur and then married her through nikah. First, know how Furkan trapped the woman... Now read in 3 points what allegations the woman made... Woman says, 'Want to return to Hinduism' The woman says that now she wants to return to her Hindu religion. She will go to Haridwar and embrace Hinduism. She will also take a bath in the Ganges and have darshan of the Goddess there. Meanwhile, Yamunanagar City Police Station investigating officer Sumit Kamboj said that a case has been registered against the woman's husband and brother-in-law based on her complaint. The allegations made by the woman are being investigated.

stories.title: Lance Naik Drigpal Singh’s brave stand during 1971 war:Indian soldier destroys enemy bunker, inspires troops, sacrifices life to secure Ghazi Post in Fazilka sector
stories.summary: On the evening of December 3, 1971, Pakistani fighter jets suddenly attacked several Indian airfields, escalating tensions that had been building for months. This marked the beginning of the third war between India and Pakistan. Soon after the air strikes, Pakistan launched a ground offensive from the Suleimanki border in Punjab’s Fazilka sector. As the Indian Army prepared to retaliate, enemy pressure intensified. In the initial phase, Indian forces struggled to halt the fierce advance, as Pakistani troops targeted border villages and pushed about seven kilometres into Indian territory, spreading panic among civilians in the agricultural region. As Pakistani forces captured key areas like Beriwala and Kurmikhera and advanced toward Fazilka, the Indian Army headquarters ordered that Fazilka be defended at all costs to prevent deeper penetration into Punjab and Rajasthan. On December 8, the task of pushing back the enemy was assigned to the 15 Rajput, 4 Jat, and 3 Assam Regiments, led by Lieutenant Colonel Sham Thatte. Before the assault, Colonel Thatte addressed his troops, reminding them of their duty and sacrifice. When Lance Naik Drigpal Singh said he wished his shroud to be the Tricolour, the moment captured the spirit of the regiment. Colonel Thatte inspired the soldiers, stressing that despite enemy strength, they possessed unmatched courage. He then ordered the advance, declaring that they would either secure victory or achieve martyrdom worthy of history. Cold night of December 12 Pakistanis had firmly established control over Beriwala. Even after days of fighting, the Pakistani army was not letting India advance. Charlie Company's commanding officer, Major Lalit Mohan, was worried. The responsibility of destroying the Ghazi post also belonged to this company. One section of the company had suffered heavy losses. Major Lalit was sitting with his soldiers. The Major opened the map and started explaining the plan ahead- "Today, we have lost many of our comrades, but our company does not lack brave sons. The next platoon will advance under Lance Naik Drigpal's command." Drigpal stood silently. His chest swelled with pride on hearing that it was now his section's (the smallest unit of the army) turn to advance. Drigpal's eyes were fixed on the map. Major Lalit said- "Fazilka must not fall into enemy hands. They have always had their eyes on this area. Even in the '65 war, there was an attempt to capture it. Do you know why?" Drigpal replied in a low voice- "Sir, the reason is clear. If Fazilka falls into their hands, India's grip on entire Punjab will weaken." Hearing Drigpal's answer, Lalit Mohan said- "Well done...! But we also need their Ghazi post. Do you have any plan for that?" Drugpal said, "The Sutlej river is in between. Going straight won't be easy. The water is cold, and the current is strong. If we need to reach Ghazi post, we'll have to attack from behind. So that our soldiers don't come in direct range of the Pakistanis." After pausing for a while, Drugpal said, "Sir, we will crawl. No matter how much we have to crawl, the enemy won't even get a hint." Hearing Lance Naik Drugpal's plan, Major Lalit Mohan could see a ray of hope. December 13 Lance Naik Drugpal's unit was moving forward. The enemy's resistance was strong. Heavy fire was coming from Medium Machine Guns (MMG). The unit was suffering significant losses, but they kept moving forward. To avoid the firing, Lance Naik Drugpal, Sipahi Jameel Ahmad, and Ranvir Singh were hiding in a small trench. Artillery shells were falling nearby. Drugpal said in a low voice- "Jameel, Ranveer, listen carefully... There is firing from two MMGs over there. We have to crawl to the bunker. Then we'll attack with grenades. No hurry, we'll take as much time as needed. We'll cover each other." Jameel nodded and said- "Yes, sir, understood... but it's very cold, fingers are freezing. It's becoming difficult to hold the rifle." Drigpal looked at him and said, "Everyone is facing the same. Focus on the enemy, not on your hands." After this, Lance Naik Drigpal's unit descended like fury on the Pakistanis. Artillery shells being fired from behind were falling on enemy posts, and soldiers at the front foot were raining bullets. Still, that bunker from where Pakistanis were firing bursts from machine guns remained standing. The Lance Naik shouted to all his companions- "We won't get better cover than this. Move towards the bunker as fast as you can. I'll go from the front. Jameel and Ranveer from the west, others from the south. We'll advance in the shape of the English letter U." During Charlie Company's attack, many Pakistani soldiers retreated from their positions. They stayed on the back foot for a while, but suddenly the machine gun roared again. Rattling bullets started passing by the Indian soldiers. Many soldiers were wounded. Some achieved martyrdom. An Indian tank was also destroyed. Now there was no time to think. Whatever had to be done had to be done immediately. Drigpal raised his head, assessed the situation, and shouted - "Crawl... Move forward... Crawl..." Drigpal's eyes were still fixed on that Pakistani bunker. Drigpal was about 200 meters away from the bunker. He started crawling forward on his stomach on the cold ground. Suddenly, he signaled to his companions behind, saying- "Provide cover fire..." Cover fire for Drigpal started coming from the west and south. Drigpal began advancing from the center. Pakistani soldiers would fire sometimes to the south and sometimes to the west. Machine gun fire was coming continuously. Suddenly, a bullet came straight towards Ranveer. He fell there clutching his chest. Jameel ran to him. Ranveer was trying to say something- "Sir..." But before that, he breathed his last. Drigpal looked back. Seeing his companion fall like this, his throat choked up, but this was not the time to shed tears. He ordered in a stern voice- "Jameel... move forward. We have to silence the bunker. Move forward for Ranveer. The @@# whose bullet hit him, his mother is @#?@." Jameel said through gritted teeth- "Yes, sir..." Now, only Jameel was left to provide cover in the western direction. The bunker was now just 50 meters away. As the danger increased, Lance Naik Drigpal's courage also grew. This was now a close-quarter battle. Drigpal took out a grenade from his pocket. Pulled the pin and threw it over the bunker. There was a loud explosion, and the first Pakistani bunker turned to ashes. With the blast, a Pakistani soldier was thrown out and fell. He had only suffered minor injuries. Drugpal signaled to Jameel. When Jameel tried to catch him, a scuffle broke out between them. Jameel took out a knife from his rifle and struck, but the enemy counter-attacked. The knife plunged into Jameel's arm. Jameel fell down. The Pakistani soldier was about to stab Jameel in the chest when Drugpal shot him. Just then, a bullet hit Drugpal's left shoulder. Lance Naik Drugpal and Jameel were both covered in blood. Jameel asked in pain - "Sir... are you alright?" Drugpal was lying on the ground. He said jokingly, "Jameel... are you alive?" Jameel replied - "You're alive too, sir..." Both laughed together. One enemy bunker had been destroyed, but Charlie Company had also suffered heavy losses. Ranveer had been martyred. Drugpal, Jameel, and some comrades were wounded, but the battle was not over yet. After first aid, Lance Naik Drigpal Singh started moving forward again. He explained their position to his companions, and they began crawling forward while staying close to the ground. Two bunkers were still active, and their firing was not letting Charlie Company advance. Whenever Indian soldiers tried to raise their heads, a shower of bullets would force them to duck or take cover again. Messages kept coming through the radio set - "Casualties are increasing... forward movement has stopped." Drigpal knew that if these two bunkers were not taken down, not only would capturing the enemy post be impossible, but India would not even be able to clear its own territory. He looked back. The soldiers hiding in the trench looked tired. News had already come through the radio set that India had suffered significant losses in capturing the Beriwala Bridge. As Pakistani forces advanced near the Fazilka sector in the 1971 war, Indian soldiers faced intense machine-gun fire that shook their morale. At the frontline, Charlie Company commander Major Lalit Mohan inspired the troops to stand firm. Lance Naik Drigpal Singh volunteered to destroy enemy bunkers blocking the advance and moved forward with soldier Kuldeep despite being badly wounded. Under heavy fire, Drigpal crawled inch by inch toward the bunker. Though shot through the chest while attempting to throw a grenade, he used his last strength to hurl it into the enemy post, silencing the machine gun. With his dying words, he urged his comrades to keep advancing and ensure the Tricolour flew over Ghazi Post. Drigpal Singh’s supreme sacrifice revived the regiment’s spirit and played a crucial role in the battle. For his extraordinary courage and devotion to duty, he was posthumously awarded the Maha Vir Chakra. *** Story Edit - Krishna Gopal Graphics - Saurabh Kumar *** Creative liberty has been taken to make the story interesting.

stories.title: Avimukteshwaranand says, 'I won't step back':Some people tried to enter the camp; raise slogan ‘Yogi Zindabad’
stories.summary: The dispute between Avimukteshwaranand and the fair administration in Prayagraj has been ongoing for 7 days. On Saturday night, 10 to 15 youths from an organization called Kattar Sanatani Sena arrived chanting slogans with saffron flags. They tried to enter Shankaracharya's camp. They started raising slogans of 'I Love Bulldozer' and 'CM Yogi Zindabad'. There was also pushing and shoving with Avimukteshwaranand's disciples. The commotion continued for 15 minutes. The organization's head is said to be a person named Sachin Singh. After this, Shankaracharya's disciples covered the camp from all sides. They blocked the entrance paths. The head of Shankaracharya's camp has filed a complaint at the police station. He stated that antisocial elements had come with sticks and flags. They were determined to forcefully enter the camp and engage in violence. The servants present at the camp convinced them to leave, but the situation was quite serious. A major incident could have occurred. Shankaracharya sits outside the camp. If these mischievous people attack again, Shankaracharya's life could be in danger. In such a situation, Shankaracharya's security should be ensured. Earlier, Avimukteshwaranand's disciples had warned about the threat to Shankaracharya's life. They had said - the administration and its goons are roaming around. What happened on Mauni Amavasya? On January 18, during the Magh Mela, Avimukteshwaranand was going to bathe in a palanquin on Mauni Amavasya. Police stopped him and asked him to go on foot. When protested, there was pushing and shoving with disciples. Upset by this, Avimukteshwaranand sat on a protest outside the camp. The administration issued two notices to Avimukteshwaranand within 48 hours. The first questioned his use of the Shankaracharya title, and the second raised questions about the commotion during Mauni Amavasya. The administration had warned that you should not be permanently banned from the Magh Mela. Avimukteshwaranand had sent responses to both notices.

stories.title: Moradabad Class 12 student alleges friends forced to wear burqa:Girl says, 'she was misled, brother lodges FIR'; police begin investigation into alleged conversion attempt
stories.summary: Perhaps my destiny was good. My eyes opened early. Otherwise, I, too, might have been found somewhere in 35 pieces. My Muslim friends were constantly instigating me to adopt Islam. They said Islam is very good. They told me to eat meat and made me wear a burqa. Gradually, I started liking everything they said. As if they had cast some spell on me, hypnotized me. They would mix something in my food. This is what a Hindu student from Moradabad studying in 12th grade has to say. She was made to wear a burqa by her 5 Muslim friends. After the video came out, Dainik Bhaskar spoke with the student. She says - Now my eyes are completely opened. The influence my Muslim friends had on me has now worn off. Now I want them to be punished. So that they don't try to mislead any other Hindu girl again. First, let's talk about the incident... 5 Muslim students forcibly made Hindu friend wear burqa This incident is from Bilari town, located on the Agra highway, about 35 km away from the district headquarters in Moradabad. About 2km away from here is Janta Inter College in Sahaspur, which has a group of science stream students. In this group of friends, there are 5 Muslim and one Hindu student. All 6 students are not only school friends but also attend chemistry tuition coaching together. They have shared a deep friendship for one and a half years. This story begins on December 20, when these five Muslim friends make their Hindu friend wear a burqa outside the coaching class. This incident gets captured on CCTV. Now, after this footage has come out, there is an uproar. The Hindu student's brother has filed an FIR at Bilari police station against the five Muslim friends, accusing them of forcibly making his sister wear a burqa and attempting religious conversion. Hindu student's father is a driver, youngest among 3 siblings The student's family lives in a neighborhood in Bilari town. Father drives a school van. The student is the youngest among three siblings. Both elder brothers run mobile shops in the town. The student is good at studies. She dreams of becoming a doctor after completing her education. Now the story of that student who was made to wear burqa by Muslim students... Friendship started one and half years ago, she said - they would take her to restaurants About one and a half years ago, when I was in 11th class, I met these five girls in college. First, I became friends with Alina. Alina introduced me to the other 4 Muslim girls. Alina would often tell me that Islam is a very good religion. She would urge me to leave Hinduism and accept Islam. She would also encourage me to wear a burqa and eat meat. I don't know what happened, but gradually I started liking the talks of Alina and her 4 other friends. Slowly, I felt that whatever they were saying was right. On December 20, Alina made me wear a burqa, and then all five Muslim friends took me with them to a restaurant. They used to take me to this restaurant before, too. Surprisingly, whenever I went to this restaurant with Muslim friends, the waiter would not bring the food order; Alina or her other Muslim friend would bring the food. I am sure they were mixing something in my food. I was kind of hypnotized. My eyes opened in time. Otherwise, I too might have been found in 35 pieces packed in a bag somewhere, like Delhi's Shraddha. Who knows what my Muslim friends' plan was ahead? Maybe they would ask me to have an affair with a Muslim boy, or they would take me somewhere and sell me. Now brother's statement All five could have even sold my sister Brother said - My sister was forcefully made to wear a burqa. Everything is clearly visible in the video. My sister also told me that those girls would provoke her to wear a burqa, saying you'll look good in a burqa. They would tell my sister to eat non-veg, saying it would taste good. Eat gravy-gravy. They forcefully took my sister to restaurants. They would mix something in her food. Alina repeatedly urged her to accept Islam. My sister was hypnotized through black magic. My sister came completely under their control. We got her treated at many places and had spiritual healing done, only then did her condition improved. We found out about the incident in time, otherwise her five Muslim friends would have taken my sister somewhere and sold her. Some people have made my sister's video viral on social media without blurring her face. Now the Muslim student's statement She herself used to say put a burqa on me, she bought the niqab herself In this case, the main accused, Aleena told Dainik Bhaskar - I don't understand why my Hindu friend is making these allegations against me. I never asked her to wear a burqa or accept Islam. We are all in the same class and have known each other since the 11th class. We had a good friendship. She herself liked to dress like us. She liked the burqa. That day, she also insisted on wearing the burqa. I had taken my burqa to the tailor for alterations. She said, I want to try it once. In fact, she bought the niqab herself. She had said many times that get me a burqa too. She never came to my house. So, using black magic in food and drinks is beyond understanding. Now we don't know why they have filed an FIR against us. Alina's father is a welding laborer, family is poor Alina is a resident of Thanwala village, about 6 km away from Bilari town. Her father is a welding laborer. Alina's house is located among narrow lanes in Thanwala. She is third among eight siblings. Two of her five sisters are pursuing graduation. Two sisters and three brothers are younger than Alina. Despite financial constraints, Alina has a deep interest in studies. 4 female students from Sahaspur left home to stay with relatives In this case, the other 4 named female students are residents of Sahaspur near Bilari. We tried to talk to these students by reaching out to their homes. Even after many attempts, they and their family members were not ready to talk. They feel that if they say anything, the matter will escalate further. However, it was definitely learned that these female students left their homes and went to stay with their relatives. They fear that the police could knock on their doors at any time to arrest them.

stories.title: System responsible for Noida engineer Yuvraj's death; 7 held accountable:SIT questions 2-hour delay in rescue, multiple officials and builders blamed in drowning accident
stories.summary: On the night of January 16 in Noida, software engineer Yuvraj died due to drowning in water. A Special Investigation Team (SIT) was formed by the administration regarding the incident. SIT asked more than 22 questions from three departments, including the Authority. Noida Authority submitted its 150-page report, while the Police Department submitted a 450-page report. SIT's question was why there was a 2-hour delay in the rescue? Officials could not provide an answer to this. The SIT team departed for Meerut with these reports. According to sources, the death of Yuvraj Mehta in Noida is emerging not as an accident, but as a system failure. This fact has come to light in the reports of the police and the Noida Authority. After analyzing the SIT report, it will be submitted to CM Yogi Adityanath. These reports have held certain specific individuals responsible. Who was found at fault and why, read the report... The responsibility for maintaining Noida city lies with the Authority's CEO. Despite the accident near the plot, subordinate officers were not questioned. After file approval, work on the road cut was not progressed. Following up on this is the CEO's responsibility. This is why, after removing the Junior Engineer, the first major action was taken against CEO Lokesh M. He has been removed from his position and placed on the waiting list. Further action will be taken after the SIT report. Noida DM Medha Rupam is the district's Disaster Management Head. Even after being the head, no departmental action was taken. She reached the spot with the SIT on the fourth day after the accident. Did not even talk to Yuvraj's family. However, just a day before the incident, she had held a meeting with disaster management. After the police, only the fire brigade team reached the spot for rescue when Yuvraj's car was submerged in water. The employees said that we don't know how to swim, and we don't have equipment either. Being the Chief Fire Officer, he did not reach the spot, nor did he guide any employee. After the accident, police reached the cut spot first. The response time of Dial-112 was correct according to visibility, but SHO Sarvesh Singh did not reach the spot. He also did not inform the officials about the rescue operation from his end. SIT also asked him why he did not inform NDRF on time. The builders against whom FIR was registered in Yuvraj Mehta's death case include Abhay Kumar, Sanjay Kumar, Manish Kumar, Achal Vohra, and Nirmal Kumar. So far, 4 builders have been arrested. The plot where water was filled, and the accident happened, belongs to Abhay Kumar, which is registered under the name of Biz Town Planner. They dug the pit in the basement and left it empty. Now, water was filled here, due to which even after the car fell, Yuvraj could not safely get out. SP Singh, GM of Noida Traffic Cell, has the most important role in the entire accident. NTC's responsibility was to identify black spots and install reflectors, signboards, dividers, and complete safety standards there, which SP Singh failed to do. Water Sewer GM RP Singh's job in Noida's drainage is to check if sewage water is accumulating anywhere. Sewage water from more than 10,000 people from about 12 societies was reaching this plot. The broken drainage line had become the medium. In 2023, the Irrigation Department was supposed to build a head regulator here, but this was not followed up. Investigation team recorded statements of more than 100 people The death of Yuvraj Mehta due to a car drowning is now emerging not just as an accident, but as a case of administrative negligence, rescue system failure, and officials' irresponsibility. The Special Investigation Team conducting the investigation recorded final statements from over 100 people involved in SDRF, Police, Control Room, and Rescue Operations, Authority. We share with you the SIT's questions to the Authority and their answers from sources... SIT. What did the Authority do after the accident on December 16 night? Authority. Security arrangements were made at the site. Along with this, after inspection, based on the preliminary report, the Junior Engineer of the Traffic Cell was removed from service. Show cause notices were issued to others. A team was formed under the leadership of three General Managers for investigation. SIT. On December 31, at the same place, a truck first crashed into the drain after losing control, breaking the drain. What did the Authority do after this? Authority. No information about any such incident was provided by the police or local residents. Nor did this incident come to notice. SIT. What were the safety arrangements on the road where the accident occurred? Authority. All necessary road safety arrangements, including painting on breakers, cat eyes, and diversion boards, have been made by the traffic cell in the sector. SIT. What action was taken regarding plot allotment, map approval information, and the builder's violation of rules? Authority. Plot No. 2 of Sports City was allotted in July 2014. Lead developer Lotus Greens subdivided 27185 square meters of land in favor of Vij Town Builder. The builder has dues of 129 crore rupees. Notice was issued regarding this. In 2017, one map was approved by the authority, then in 2022, the application for map modification was rejected. Additionally, notices were issued to complete the construction. SIT. How many complaints were received before Sector-150, and what did the Authority do about them? Authority. Complaints received from sector residents were resolved. Several works that were to be done by the authority have been completed. The remaining process is ongoing. 12:20 AM (Night) Call came saying 'Please save me', father says - I ran as soon as I heard Father Rajkumar says - Around 12:20 AM on Friday night, I was lying on the bed. Suddenly, I got a call from my son, Yuvraj. He was supposed to come home, so I couldn't understand why he was calling me. I picked up the phone. A panicked voice came from the other end. He said- Papa...Papa I've fallen into the drain, I don't want to die. Please save me. After hearing this, I ran out in the clothes I was wearing. Before leaving the society, I typed a message and posted it on the society's group, so that help could arrive. The drain my son mentioned was 200 meters away from our society. I ran to that drain. Here, I spent 30 minutes trying to search for my son in the dense fog and darkness, shouting to get a response. Then I felt that I was searching in the wrong place. 12:30 PM Said to people making videos - Please save my son After this, I reached the road cut, where construction of a building was incomplete. A pit was dug here for the basement. Upon reaching there, I started shouting, hearing my voice son also screamed... help... help. After hearing the voice saying "Help me", I understood that my son had fallen here. I went a little further ahead, through the fog, and I saw that the car was in the water and my son was lying on its roof. He was 50 to 60 feet away from the road. He was slowly sinking. He kept turning his mobile phone light on and off so that we standing on the shore would know he was alive. I called Dial-112. It was around 12:30 at that time. I was watching him sink in front of me. There were other people there too, but no one was helping. Some people were making videos, I told them - Please don't make videos, help my son. Understand how the search operation was conducted 12:50 PM Crane reached 30 feet, Yuvraj was 50 feet away Around 12:45 AM, police and a fire truck arrived at the scene with Dial-112. By then, the fog had become dense. Visibility was almost zero. First, the police and fire team tried to rescue by throwing a rope. However, the rope was not reaching Yuvraj. Some police officers were saying the water is very cold, and how to get in. Some were saying there could be iron rods at the bottom of the site. After this, a crane was called. But the crane also could not reach Yuvraj. It was only going 30-40 feet. No one present was trying to get into the water. The father said that the pit was probably 15 to 20 feet deep, so if divers were there, his son's life could have been saved. 1:45 PM SDRF was called, but the car sank The SDRF team arrived at 1:15 AM. They also did not have adequate resources. Everyone was screaming save him, do something. Father says - I was ready to get into the water myself, but the police didn't let me go forward. Around 1:45 AM, Yuvraj's car was completely submerged in water. Yuvraj, who was lying on top of it, also disappeared into the water. We could only watch this happen. 80 employees conducted search operation for 2 hours The NDRF team arrived around quarter to two. 30 personnel from SDRF and NDRF had already arrived. 50 personnel from the police and fire department were present there. Around 80 people conducted the rescue and search operation. The team went into the water with the help of searchlights, a crane, and a ladder. After 2 hours of hard work, Yuvraj's body was recovered around 4:15. He was taken to the hospital, where doctors declared that he had stopped breathing.

stories.title: Rain and storm alert in 20 districts of UP:Icy winds intensify cold, Ayodhya coldest; temperature to drop by up to 6°C in two days
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh’s weather has changed drastically due to recent rains and hail. Cold winds blowing from the mountains have intensified the chill. Today, the Meteorological Department has issued alerts for rain in 15 districts and thunderstorms with winds of 40–50 km/h in 20 districts. Temperatures are expected to drop by 5–6°C. The weather department stated that heavy snowfall and torrential rains in the Himalayan states are now visibly affecting Uttar Pradesh. Over the past two days, the eastern and western regions of the state have received significant rainfall, with Sambhal recording the highest at 95 mm. Earlier, on Friday and Saturday, 30 districts, including Lucknow, Kanpur, Hardoi, Noida, and Ghaziabad, received rain. Hailstones the size of peas fell in Meerut, Hathras, and Etawah, damaging crops in the fields. Lightning strikes were reported in Barabanki, Etah, and three other districts, causing a fire in a church. This spell of rain is expected to resume after January 26, with moderate rainfall across the state on January 27 and 28. Agricultural experts say that while unseasonal rain benefits crops like wheat, lentils, and chickpeas, it is harming mustard and potatoes. Farmers are advised to monitor the weather closely and apply pesticides if necessary. In the past 24 hours, Ayodhya recorded the lowest temperature at 8°C, making it the coldest city, while Lucknow registered the highest minimum temperature in the state at 15.4°C. According to meteorological data, Friday night in Lucknow was the fourth warmest night of January in its history, after 2005, 2007, and 2019. Alerts for today: Hail in 15 districts: Saharanpur, Shamli, Muzaffarnagar, Meerut, Hapur, Bulandshahr, Aligarh, Kasganj, Bijnor, Amroha, Moradabad, Rampur, Bareilly, Sambhal, Badaun, and surrounding areas. Thunderstorms in 20 districts: Saharanpur, Shamli, Muzaffarnagar, Baghpat, Meerut, Ghaziabad, Hapur, Gautam Buddha Nagar, Bulandshahr, Aligarh, Kasganj, Bijnor, Amroha, Moradabad, Rampur, Bareilly, Pilibhit, Shahjahanpur, Sambhal, Badaun, and surrounding areas. Why did the weather change suddenly? The impact of an active western disturbance in northwest India is now visible in Uttar Pradesh. Increased cloud movement and a shift in wind direction from easterly to westerly have raised humidity levels, creating conditions for rain in several areas. Weather forecast for the next 4 days: January 26: Mostly clear skies with isolated light rain. Cold winds expected. January 27: Light rain in some areas. Cloudy skies with a temperature drop. January 28: Thunderstorms with rain in western UP; light rain in eastern UP. January 29: Light rain with possible thunderstorms; strong winds may occur in some regions. Atul Kumar Singh, senior scientist at the Regional Meteorological Center, Lucknow, stated that another western disturbance will become active from January 27. Day-night temperature fluctuations will continue. While minimum temperatures may rise in western UP, cloudy conditions in central UP will cause daytime temperatures to drop.

stories.title: First winter rain in Kanpur changes weather:Cold intensifies, maximum temperature drops by 2.2 degrees, chances of rain again for two days
stories.summary: Late night in Kanpur, the first rain of the winter season was recorded, which brought a change in the city's weather. According to the report issued by the Weather Department of Chandra Shekhar Azad University of Agriculture and Technology (CSA), a total of 4 millimeters of rain was recorded in the city. This rain after a long time increased the humidity in the atmosphere and somewhat reduced the effect of the cold. Six trains arrived at Kanpur Central behind schedule. Minimum temperature 5.5 degrees higher After the rain, a slight increase in minimum temperature was recorded. According to CSA's weather report, the minimum temperature was recorded at 13.0 degrees Celsius, which is 5.5 degrees Celsius above normal. Mild cold persisted during the night and morning, but due to the higher minimum temperature, people got relief from severe cold. Sunlight came and went during afternoon Weather improved during the afternoon hours. Though the sun came out, there was an alternating pattern of sun and shade due to cloud movement. Sunlight couldn't reach full intensity, which maintained the feeling of cold throughout the day. An increase was recorded in the maximum temperature. In the past 24 hours, the maximum temperature increased by 2.2 degrees Celsius, reaching 21.8 degrees Celsius. This was 0.8 degrees Celsius above normal. Temperature likely to drop Weather expert Dr. SN Sunil Pandey said that snowfall is occurring in the mountains. Due to moisture, clouds may cover some places in the next 24 hours. After January 27, clouds will come again. There is a possibility of rain again from the evening of the 27th till January 28th. After this temperatures will drop. Cold weather will continue till the first week of February. Due to increased humidity in the air from rain, mild cold can be felt during morning and night time in the coming days. Meanwhile, no significant drop in daytime temperature has been predicted for now. Sunlight may remain weak due to cloud cover. stories.title: What is the solution to Avimukteshwaranand-Administration dispute?:Saints-Sadhus divided; How a small incident became UP's biggest controversy
stories.summary: The dispute with Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand Saraswati at the Magh Mela has divided both the Sanatan society and politics. The insistence on Ganga bath in palanquin, clash with police and then beating of disciples has brought turmoil in UP politics. Shankaracharya's hunger strike and two notices from the fair administration questioning the Shankaracharya title, has now become not just about crowd management, but a major center of religious respect, administrative strictness and political games. UP politics has been boiling for 7 days. In this Sunday Big Story read whether this controversy is just a clash between a saint and fair rules? Is it right to be called 'Shankaracharya' despite the position being under consideration in Supreme Court? Is it damaging the government's image? Is opposition getting political mileage? First read about the dispute... On January 18, during Mauni Amavasya, a conflict arose between Avimukteshwaranand and his devotees with the police-administration while going for the Triveni bath. The police-administration claims that Avimukteshwaranand insisted on going with a palanquin in a crowd of lakhs, which could have caused disorder in the fair. Meanwhile, Avimukteshwaranand claims that the police-administration insulted him. Their supporters, especially the young disciples, had their hair pulled and were beaten and prevented from bathing. Since then, Avimukteshwaranand has been on hunger strike at the site. Political experts say that if the fair administration had handled this properly, the controversy would not have escalated. Battle between Police-Administration and Government vs Avimukteshwaranand Now this battle has transformed from Police-Administration vs Avimukteshwaranand to Government vs Avimukteshwaranand. We spoke with some high-ranking officials in the government. Tried to understand why the government is not resolving this matter. On condition of anonymity, an official said that the government stands firm on its position. They are not in the mood to back down at any cost. This is why it's clearly visible in the statements from the party's national spokesperson to UP CM Yogi himself. UP CM Yogi Adityanath himself, at an event in Haryana on Thursday, took a jibe by comparing Avimukteshwaranand to Kalnemi without naming him. It has been decided at the government level that the entire dispute was between the Mela administration and Avimukteshwaranand. However, this is deliberately being used as a basis to defame the government. The government has decided that Avimukteshwaranand has violated the fair rules. Based on the notice given to him and his response, further action will be taken by the fair administration. No statement will be issued at the government level, nor will any clarification be presented. The way Congress-SP is giving political color to this matter, spokespersons will try to prove that this entire controversy is not religious but political. Avimukteshwaranand has become a pawn of political parties. This is why the administration has already issued two notices to Avimukteshwaranand, which clearly show that the administration is also firm on its stand. Avimukteswranand will not accept anything less than an apology Meanwhile, the Avimukteswranand camp, who has been on hunger strike since the incident, has also made it clear that until the administration or government apologizes for this entire episode, they will not back down. On Friday, he was gripped by a high fever. Still, he does not appear to be backing down from his decision. A source connected to the Avimukteswaranand camp claims that some saints tried to negotiate a compromise, but the position of Shankaracharya is very prestigious and respected in Sanatan. In such a situation, if Avimukteswranand steps back, it will send a message that Sanatan has become weak. Avimukteswranand himself has said that in 2015, the SP government had ordered a lathi charge on him, but when the government later apologized, I forgave them. Similarly, this time too, if the administration and government apologize for their mistake and respectfully allow me to go for bathing, I am ready to end the hunger strike. Conflict with government is not new Why are governments upset with Swami Avimukteshwaranand? It's important to look at the background to understand this. Actually, Swami Avimukteshwaranand has two main issues. First- declaring the cow as the national mother. Second- provision for strict punishment for those who slaughter cows. Their movement regarding these two demands has been going on for many years. They are going to hold a big event in Delhi on March 10-11 regarding this. In this conference, prominent religious leaders from across the country will be asked whether they have given blessings to any political party. If they have given blessings, then why is that party silent on the issue of cow protection? The Shankaracharyas of all four peeths, along with sadhus and sanyasis from across the country, have been invited to the event. Avimukteshwaranand Saraswati, who visited Meerut a few days ago, said - No political party has openly supported us on the issue of cow protection. After this, we asked cow protectors to contest elections in Bihar. 198 such cow protectors/candidates contested the Bihar Assembly elections. They received 5 lakh 86 thousand 13 votes. This means an average of three thousand votes were received in the name of cow protection from each assembly constituency. If political parties still don't take any steps for cow protection even after this, we will ask cow protectors to contest elections in West Bengal and UP assembly elections as well. Avimukteshwaranand is also getting political support Avimukteshwaranand is receiving political support from SP-Congress. Akhilesh Yadav himself has called and spoken to him. SP is promoting this entire matter by linking it to the insult of Sanatan and is blaming the BJP for it. Leader of Opposition Mata Prasad Pandey had also gone to meet him during the bath at Magh Mela. Additionally, Sandeep Yadav, who was previously a candidate from SP for Prayagraj North, is continuously supporting him at the Magh Mela. Congress state president Ajay Rai, along with Prayagraj MP Ujjwal Raman Singh, has also met Avimukteshwaranand with his father Revati Raman. Congress is also actively supporting him and issuing statements. For the first time, the opposition has got an opportunity to accuse the BJP of being anti-Hindu, which they are capitalizing on. RSS and VHP's Stand - Wait and Watch Vishwa Hindu Parishad believes that such a dispute should not have occurred at the Magh Mela. Rules and laws are equal for everyone. If there is a ban on going to the Sangam sitting on a palanquin, then Shankaracharya should have followed it. However, the incident of pulling Batuk's hair and physical assault is condemnable. Such incidents weaken Hindu unity. No statement has come from the RSS on this matter so far. This is also because saints and those who have faith in Sanatan appear divided over this entire episode. While one large section considers Avimukteshwaranand responsible for this dispute, another section blames the police-administration's stubbornness as the reason for this controversy. A large section believes that as a saint, Avimukteshwaranand should have followed the system. If the administration did not give permission to travel in a palanquin, they could have gone on foot. Saints and mahants of various monasteries and temples are also criticizing him on this issue. However, everyone agrees on the incident of pulling Batuks by their hair and assault. Along with condemning this, they are demanding action against the police personnel involved in the assault. Government only worried about image Political experts say that first, the controversy over breaking Devi Ahilyabai's statue at Manikarnika Ghat in Varanasi, then two consecutive incidents of insulting Avimukteshwaranand at the Prayagraj Magh Mela have damaged the government's image. For the first time, the opposition has got a chance to accuse BJP of being anti-Hindu. The way common people are reacting in both cases, the government's concern is bound to increase. A large section of the Sanatan society is calling it inappropriate to stop Shankaracharya and pull the tuft of young priests. CM Yogi himself has an image of a firebrand Hindutva, but these incidents have also damaged his image. This is the main concern of the government. This is why, while CM Yogi has taken a strict stand on this matter, his colleague Deputy CM Keshav Prasad Maurya has given a balanced response, urging an end to this issue. On Thursday, Keshav Prasad Maurya said in a media interaction that while paying respects at the feet of revered Shankaracharya, we request him to take a bath. There is no provision for disrespecting any revered saint or Shankaracharya. If anyone has done so, we will investigate and take action. Keshav's statement is being described as an attempt to appease the Hindutva vote bank. Then what will be the path to reconciliation? Experts believe that the matter between the government and Avimukteshwaranand Saraswati has deteriorated so much that it will now only be resolved through intervention at a higher level (RSS and BJP national leadership). There has always been a general perception in BJP and Sangh regarding Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand that he speaks in opposition. But regarding this matter, the way the opposition is engaged in portraying the BJP as anti-Hindu, the top leadership of RSS and the BJP is certainly concerned. That's why some initiative may come from their level. What happened later? This case has been ongoing in the Supreme Court since 2022. Swami Avimukteshwaranand Saraswati has been using the word Shankaracharya with his name since then. Recently, Swami Avimukteshwaranand responded to a notice from the Prayagraj Mela Authority. In this, he wrote that the Supreme Court has not given any order prohibiting me from continuing in the position of Shankaracharya. Letters from several governors, governments/key public representatives were shown on behalf of Avimukteshwaranand, in which he was addressed as Shankaracharya. On January 22 itself, UP Deputy CM Keshav Prasad Maurya addressed him as Pujya Shankaracharya in his statement.
